...

橫濱水手早前聯賽經歷四連和後，上仗交出表現在主場以4比2擊敗川崎前鋒打破悶局。球隊防守力屬聯賽前列，上仗尋回入球節奏下更大破對手，而四個入球均來自不同球員，當中包括傷癒復出的前鋒遠野大彌，其回歸將對整體戰力有所提升。上仗表現增強了球隊信心，今仗預計將繼續保持勇態迎戰對手。

岡山綠雉上仗主場0比4負FC東京，全場控球率大約40%，對手有近20次射門機會。球隊近五場聯賽四敗，若要提升成績，須先改善入球能力及控球。季初所得積分讓球隊仍守在第十位，若今仗落敗下沉難免，為免承受更大壓力預計會盡全力爭取分數。

橫濱水手上仗轟入四球，岡山綠雉預期將採取堅守策略，甚至悶和對手。賽事相信會以和局完場。

對賽

兩隊在日職百年構想聯賽並無交手。2025年日職交手為首次聯賽對陣，岡山綠雉兩場皆以1比0取勝。

数据拆解师 2026-11-06 18:28

11月07日，2026-2027赛季日职联第14轮，横滨水手坐镇主场迎来冈山绿雉。13轮联赛过后，横滨水手拿到5胜6平2负，积分21分，排在第8位，进20球失14球；冈山绿雉5胜1平7负，积分16分，排在第10位，进15球失21球。两队排名相邻，本场结果直接影响积分榜中段位置。

横滨水手主场6战3胜2平1负，进13球失9球，最近6个主场5胜1平0负，进16球失9球，胜率达到83%。上一场主场4比2击败川崎前锋，排出4-2-3-1，远野大弥第12分钟首开纪录，近藤友喜第28分钟接山根陆助攻扩大比分，基尼奥内斯第56分钟接松村晃助助攻破门。谷村海那联赛已进7球，射门29次、射正12次；松村晃助贡献5次助攻。从上一场首发看，主教练若延续4-2-3-1，赛季传球成功率77.6%、关键传球112次，球队仍需用连续传递创造机会。

冈山绿雉近6场联赛只取得1胜0平5负，进5球失13球；横滨水手近6场联赛2胜4平0负，进9球失5球。上一场主场0比4不敌FC东京，冈山绿雉以3-4-2-1首发，全场射正4次、控球39%，下半场连续失球。联赛至今，冈山绿雉场均进球1.2个、场均失球1.6个；客场6战2胜0平4负，进8球失10球。卢考联赛射门30次、助攻4次，罗相浩射正8次，河野孝汰进3球。田上大地在9月30日遭遇膝关节伤，小仓幸成在8月13日遭遇膝关节伤，中后场轮换受影响。若主教练继续使用3-4-2-1，三中卫需要承受横滨水手在禁区前沿连续传递。

双方近2次交手，横滨水手2025年6月21日主场0比1负于冈山绿雉，冈山绿雉2025年3月29日主场1比0取胜。冈山绿雉日职联赛季场均角球6.4个、关键传球135次，快攻转化率22.2%；横滨水手场均角球4.1个、快攻转化率6.7%。主队近6个主场保持不败，客队近6场联赛输掉5场，冈山绿雉能否用三中卫限制横滨水手边中结合？横滨水手能否把主场不败延续到第14轮？

北京时间2026年11月7日13:00周六，日职联第14轮，横滨水手主场对冈山绿雉，本场是竞彩周六001的比赛。懂球帝数据模型按开球前的历史比赛数据算出综合预测：横滨水手胜57%、平局22%、冈山绿雉胜21%，最可能的比分是1-1（9.7%）、2-1（9.5%）、2-0（7.8%），预计两队合计进3.4球左右，两队都进球的概率64%。

泊松进球模型按本赛季日职联场均进球算出两队主客场进攻和防守强度，相乘得到进球期望，再按泊松分布算每个比分概率，并对0-0、1-1这类低比分做Dixon-Coles修正。本赛季日职联截至赛前已赛130场，场均主队进1.63球、客队进1.33球；横滨水手6个主场场均进2.17球、失1.50球，进攻强度1.25、防守1.10；冈山绿雉6个客场场均进1.33球、失1.67球，进攻强度1.00、防守1.02；进球期望横滨水手2.07、冈山绿雉1.46。结果：横滨水手胜51%、平23%、冈山绿雉胜26%，最可能比分1-1（9.7%）、2-1（9.2%）、2-2（6.7%）。

# 富山胜利客战鸟栖砂岩，谷本骏介成关键

日职乙第16轮，富山胜利将客场挑战鸟栖砂岩，比赛将于北京时间11月7日13:00开球。富山上一轮1-0击败联赛领头羊仙台维加泰，继战胜新潟之后再次拿下强敌。鸟栖本赛季主场取得5胜2负，主场胜率71%，不会轻易丢分。

两队本赛季都主打控球，鸟栖场均控球率55.7%，富山54.3%，数据几乎持平。鸟栖场均传球528.1次，富山585次。两队总交锋记录为9场3胜3负3平，实力差距很小。富山客场6胜1负，胜率86%，形成“主场强势对客场强势”的局面。

数据方面，鸟栖场均射门16.8次、射正4.6次、传球成功率79.4%、角球7.2次、任意球11.7次、越位1.3次、犯规9.7次、黄牌0.6张、红牌0张，实际比赛时间54分47秒。富山场均射门19.6次、射正7.3次、传球成功率82.4%、角球6.4次、任意球12.1次、越位3.1次、犯规10.4次、黄牌1.4张、红牌0张，实际比赛时间59分32秒。累计数据上，富山294次射门、110次射正，鸟栖252次射门、69次射正。

鸟栖目前6胜7负2平积20分排名第12位，关键球员为中场16号西泽健太、前锋11号盐浜辽、后卫3号神山京右。富山8胜3负4平积28分排名第2位，关键球员为中场33号高桥馨希、前锋39号古川真人、中场34号竹中元汰。

本场比赛的关键球员被列为富山中场谷本骏介。他本赛季创造29次机会，队内仅次于高桥春树，并赢得31次对抗。文章认为，由于两队都擅长控球，中场控制权争夺很可能决定比赛走向，谷本骏介在攻防转换和第二落点争夺中的作用十分重要。鸟栖方面，西泽健太是主要的机会创造者。

富山上轮对阵仙台时控球率55%、传球606次，射门19比20、射正5比5，最终由高桥春树的进球打破僵局。文章预计本场上半场双方会较为谨慎，随着比赛推进，富山以高桥春树和谷本骏介为核心的传控将开始发挥作用，古川真人和吉平翼将更多威胁球门；鸟栖则会依靠西泽健太创造机会，富山压上时的快速反击需要注意。预测比分为鸟栖砂岩1-3富山胜利。

文章还提到，富山希望延续对阵新潟和仙台时的表现，证明目前的状态并非短暂连胜，并报天皇杯失利之仇。

联赛至今场均2.2个进球、1.5个失球，柏太阳神排出3-4-2-1时让藤尾翔太顶在最前，上一场用三中卫把关，本场预计延续这一结构。主场近6场4胜1平1负，打进19球丢掉9球；10月10日，马场晴也遭遇膝关节伤；9月29日，熊坂光希也遭遇膝关节伤，中后场轮换受影响。

2比4输给横滨水手上一场，乌雷莫维奇头球来自胁坂泰斗助攻，大关友翔补时阶段接小林悠传球得分；川崎前锋最近6场赢下5场，没有平局，只有1场失利，进16球失8球，联赛近6场3胜1平2负，打进14球丢掉13球。

联赛至今场均2.1个进球、1.7个失球，川崎前锋快攻次数31次、快攻转化率30.8%，马尔西尼奥进8球，胁坂泰斗37次射门16次射正4次助攻。首发4-2-3-1里德里克·莱瑟达顶在前面，马尔西尼奥和胁坂泰斗在其身后活动，本场推断仍会沿用这一结构；9月30日，野田裕人遭遇小腿伤；9月20日，谷口荣斗遭遇大腿伤。

联赛至今柏太阳神送出164次关键传球、场均角球5.3个，川崎前锋关键传球161次；川崎前锋联赛客场近6场2胜2平2负，打进10球丢掉10球。最近6次交手，有4场总进球达到4球以上；最近一次交锋柏太阳神1比0拿下，2026年2月8日川崎前锋5比3取胜。柏太阳神控球与角球能否压住川崎前锋快攻，川崎前锋能否用转换速度在客场抢分？第14轮悬念留在这里。

## 30 秒看懂

- 综合预测柏太阳神胜54%，最可能比分2-1。
- 三个模型柏太阳神胜率在48%到57%之间。
- 近5场柏太阳神3胜2平，川崎前锋4胜1负。

北京时间2026年11月7日15:00周六，日职联第14轮，柏太阳神主场对阵川崎前锋。懂球帝数据模型按开球前的历史比赛数据算出，综合三个模型的平均预测：柏太阳神胜54%、平局21%、川崎前锋胜25%；最可能的比分是2-1（8.5%）、1-1（8%）、2-2（6.7%）；预计两队合计进3.9球左右，两队都进球的概率72%。

泊松进球模型按本赛季日职联的场均进球，算出两队在主客场的进攻和防守强度，相乘得到进球期望，再按泊松分布算每个比分的概率，并对低比分做Dixon-Coles修正。本赛季日职联截至赛前已赛130场，场均主队进1.63球、客队进1.33球；柏太阳神本赛季6个主场场均进2.50球、失1.67球，进攻强度1.40、防守1.19；川崎前锋本赛季6个客场场均进1.67球、失1.67球，进攻强度1.19、防守1.02；进球期望：柏太阳神2.32、川崎前锋1.89。结果：柏太阳神胜48%、平21%、川崎前锋胜31%，最可能的比分2-1（7.6%）、1-1（7.2%）、2-2（7.1%）。

近况加权模型只看两队各项赛事最近10场，越近的比赛权重越大（每往前一场权重乘0.85），用加权后的场均进球和对手的场均失球算进球期望，主场按赛事主客场进球比例加成。柏太阳神近10场加权场均进2.45球、失0.87球；川崎前锋近10场加权场均进2.29球、失1.59球；主场加成1.11；进球期望：柏太阳神2.30、川崎前锋1.38。结果：柏太阳神胜57%、平21%、川崎前锋胜22%，最可能的比分2-1（9.2%）、1-1（8.8%）、3-1（7.1%）。

Elo等级分模型按懂球帝收录的全部正式比赛，从1500分起给每支球队算Elo等级分：赢球加分、输球扣分，对手越强、赢得越多，变动越大。赛前两队的分差加上主场优势换算成胜率期望，再结合两队预计总进球换算成各自的进球期望。赛前等级分：柏太阳神1808（已算674场）、川崎前锋1751（已算713场），主场优势按60分算；柏太阳神的胜率期望（赢算1、平算0.5）0.66；进球期望：柏太阳神2.40、川崎前锋1.55。结果：柏太阳神胜56%、平21%、川崎前锋胜23%，最可能的比分2-1（8.6%）、1-1（7.9%）、3-1（6.9%）。

# 韩媒：金泉战安养，安养争保级组榜首

【SPORTALKOREA】金京泰记者=K联赛1保级组的生存与荣誉恶战，将在周末点燃赛场。

■ 本轮焦点：力求反弹的“金泉” vs 保级组榜首争夺中的“安养”

第35轮，安养（第8位，46分）将对阵金泉（第10位，35分）。安养目前以1分之差追赶第7位的济州（47分），力争拿到保级组榜首。反观金泉，近4场都没能取胜，球队将依靠新加盟的球员寻求扭转颓势。

主场作战的金泉在第10期球员退伍后，阵容出现了变化。尤其是第13期新加入的许律、宋俊锡、卞京俊等即战力球员，在新球队里会拿出怎样的表现，值得关注。现有球员中，洪胤相近期的发挥格外亮眼。洪胤相在上一轮对光州的比赛中送出助攻，为进攻端提供了帮助；如果他本场出战，将迎来K联赛1第100场出场。金泉近4场2平2负还没有赢球，能否靠新球员和原有主力的磨合在主场拿下胜利，是本场看点。

客场作战的安养则延续着稳定上升势头，最近6场保持不败，战绩为3胜3平。上一轮对富川，安养先丢一球，随后在比赛临近结束时，马特乌斯-奥利韦拉的传中被权敬原头球破门，球队2比1逆转取胜。本赛季32场比赛，马特乌斯-奥利韦拉已经打进12球、送出7次助攻，以19个直接参与进球并列该项第二。个人生涯新高仍在继续，如果马特乌斯-奥利韦拉的状态能够延续，安养本场也有望继续保持不败，在保级组榜首争夺中占得先机。

两队本赛季3次交手，安养以1胜2平占优。金泉能否在主场取胜，借此找到反弹契机；安养又能否延续对战优势，在保级组榜首争夺中继续领跑，备受关注。金泉与安养本赛季最后一次交手，将于北京时间7日（周六）下午4点30分在金泉综合运动场举行。

# 韩媒：金泉尚武迎战安养，冲击决赛轮首胜

金泉尚武将在对阵安养时冲击决赛轮首胜。

金泉尚武职业足球队将于本周六16时30分，在金泉综合运动场迎战FC安养，进行“2026韩亚银行K联赛1”第35轮主场比赛。金泉尚武希望借此拿到决赛轮首胜，也把胜利献给主场球迷。

金泉尚武决心向安养复仇。球队希望用这场胜利洗刷上一次主场交锋失利的遗憾。要做到这一点，必须压制近5场保持不败、势头正盛的安养。尤其要提防安养以外援为核心、再加上本土球员支援的进攻。

取胜关键在于控制中场和保持防守专注。中场方面，预计国家队球员朴泰俊领衔，李康贤和卢景浩也会发挥作用。如果他们能在中场抢到主动权，就能把比赛带向有利方向。外界也关注第13期新兵球员是否会迎来意外登场。

防守端，边俊洙的作用很重要。近期作为后防主力表现出色的边俊洙，需要与中卫搭档金敏圭、坐稳主力门将位置的安俊洙一起带领防线，阻止安养的进攻。尤其要警惕对手外援的个人能力，同时把专注力保持到终场。金泉尚武希望凭借攻防两端更有整体性的表现争取3分。

金泉尚武将在这场主场比赛中准备多项活动迎接球迷。首先，入场观众将获赠助威拍手板，视天气情况，部分入口还会发放雨衣。俱乐部还会向前200名球迷赠送“金泉历史：比赛篇”照片明信片，这套明信片每场比赛可收集一张。连续10场主场比赛持有照片明信片的球迷，还能参加照片明信片收纳册赠送活动。同时，身穿主场球衣或红色系上衣的前200名球迷，将按先到先得获赠“咻呜应援棒”，俱乐部也将开展“把球场染成红色波浪”活动。

场内场外还会持续推出球迷参与型活动。场外将设置可写下助威信息的拨浪鼓制作区，以及利用俱乐部队徽、吉祥物等元素的贴花体验区。啦啦队“Shine Girls”将通过场外和赛前表演带动球场气氛，上下半场还会与“任性的李子”一起进行助威时段。半场时将举行利用“Kick”应用的职业球员问答活动，以及“半场线射门挑战第4轮”。

为纪念闵京贤完成K联赛生涯第100场出场，俱乐部也准备了活动。金泉尚武将在赛前向闵京贤颁发纪念牌和展板，庆祝这一重要纪录。场外还会举办活动，让球迷亲自给闵京贤留下祝福留言。比赛结束后，闵京贤将亲自挑选留言，并送出亲笔签名球。金泉尚武希望借助丰富活动回馈主场球迷的支持，并用胜利相报。

# 金泉尚武主场迎安养，朴泰濬领衔中场争首胜

金泉尚武将于北京时间11月7日15:30（当地时间16:30）在金泉综合运动场主场迎战安养，进行韩亚银行K联赛1 2026第35轮比赛。金泉尚武希望用一场胜利拿下附加赛阶段首胜，同时为主场球迷送上胜利。

金泉尚武本场带着复仇心态出战，此前主场与安养的交锋以失利告终。对手安养最近5场比赛保持不败，状态正佳，金泉尚武需要遏制对方以外国球员为核心、本土球员辅助的进攻。

金泉尚武认为取胜关键在于中场掌控和防守专注度。中场方面，国家队球员朴泰濬领衔，李刚现和卢京镐的发挥值得期待，第13期新兵球员是否会意外登场也受到关注。防守端，近期担任防线主力的卞俊洙作用重要，他需要与中卫搭档金旻奎、已成长为球队主力门将的安俊洙一起组织防线，限制安养外援的个人能力，并将专注保持到比赛结束。

本场比赛开始前，金泉尚武将向迎来K联赛通算100场出场的闵景现赠送纪念牌和签名板，场外也为球迷设置了向他留言祝贺的环节，赛后闵景现将亲自挑选留言并送出亲笔签名球。

金泉尚武方面表示，球队将凭借攻守两端的扎实表现力争三分，并用胜利回报主场球迷的助威。

# 韓K聯降級附加：金泉尚武vs安養FC預測分析 主場首勝懸念

資深飲水機 2026-11-06 19:06

本次帶來韓K聯降級附加第35輪，11月07日金泉尚武坐鎮主場迎戰安養FC。降級附加賽進行到這個階段，最近一段取分效率會直接映在積分榜形勢上，金泉尚武最近6場聯賽只拿到1勝3平2負，安養FC同期爲3勝3平0負。

金泉尚武這6場聯賽打入8球也丟掉8球，本賽季聯賽場均進1球，場均失球1.2個，進球轉化率7.8%，把機會變成進球能力有限。上一場客戰光州FC，第64分鐘金仁均接洪胤相助攻首開紀錄，第76分鐘被扳平，全場8次射正只換來1個進球，4-1-4-1陣型下中場控制沒有轉化爲3分。

最近6個聯賽主場，金泉尚武0勝4平2負，5個進球、7個失球，勝率0%；10月10日主場0-1輸給安養FC，10月24日主場1-2不敵大田市民。10月6日高在賢、李政宅、李建喜等租借結束離開，10月12日魚禎元、車升賢、張敏圭、徐名官以租借方式加入，陣容結構變動和磨合會影響本場排兵佈陣。高在賢聯賽8球，仍處在隊內進球榜前列，人員流動後實際首發還需要觀察。

最近6場聯賽，安養FC拿到3勝3平0負，7個進球、4個失球，聯賽場均打進1.2球、場均丟掉1.4球，11.1%進球轉化率與5.9%快攻轉化率都高於金泉尚武。奧利維拉聯賽打進12球，完成80次射門、34次射正，並送出7次助攻，安養FC進球和傳球輸送主要集中在他身上。控球不佔優時，安養FC更依賴射門轉化和快攻效率。

上一場主場對富川FC，安養FC半場0-1落後，第89分鐘權敬原接到奧利維拉助攻鎖定勝局，完成逆轉。最近6個聯賽客場，安養FC1勝3平2負，5個進球、7個失球，客場勝率17%，最近3次與金泉尚武交手取得1勝2平，最近一次是10月10日客場1-0取勝。安養FC可能繼續使用4-4-2，金泉尚武沿用4-1-4-1，主隊要解決主場首勝與轉化效率，客隊需面對客場拿分能力有限問題。

主場仍未開勝的金泉尚武，能否在安養FC身上拿到降級附加賽階段關鍵3分？近6場不敗的安養FC，又是否延續對金泉尚武近期壓制？

## Leeds vs Tottenham predictions as podcast panel weigh Elland Road edge and tight contest

The Inside Elland Road podcast panel have offered their Leeds United vs Tottenham Hotspur predictions ahead of Saturday lunchtime at Elland Road.

According to yorkshireeveningpost.co.uk, the episode features forecasts from Lee Sobot, Kyle Newbould and returning host Chris O’Connor. Leeds are winless in five league games and goalless in three after a 2-0 defeat at Bournemouth, while Spurs beat 10-man Crystal Palace for a third straight victory.
...
Sobot weighed a draw against a narrow home success, leaning on the Elland Road factor, and settled on 1-0 to Leeds. He pointed to a defence that has conceded nine in nine as reason to fancy a clean sheet.

His pick for the decisive goal was Dominic Calvert-Lewin.

Newbould noted Leeds remain unbeaten at home this season and expects another tight, not especially pretty, contest. He went for 1-1, adding that he does not see Leeds losing and naming Tarik Muharemovic as his scorer.

O’Connor outlined a path to victory built on a fast start, early pressure and set-piece threat, while accepting Spurs could enjoy long spells of possession. Despite believing Spurs’ spending should bring control, he forecast 2-1 to Leeds with Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Sean Longstaff on the scoresheet.

# Leeds vs. Tottenham Hotspur Match Preview | OneFootball

Hooligan Soccer

·6 November 2026

## Leeds vs. Tottenham Hotspur Match Preview

In-form Tottenham Hotspur travel to Elland Road on Saturday lunchtime to face a Leeds United side who are winless in five Premier League matches. A few weeks ago, Roberto De Zerbi would have been dreading this tie, especially given the excellent start to the season Leeds had enjoyed. Now, however, it is Spurs who have been playing well recently. Can they make it four in a row in Yorkshire?

### Match details

Where: Elland Road, Leeds, EnglandWhen: 12:30pm BST / 7:30am ET / 4:30am PTWatch: Broadcast live on USA Network and Univeso (Spanish)
...
### Leeds stuttering after positive start

Leeds began the season in solid fashion, going unbeaten across their opening five Premier League matches, winning two of those games. Indeed, the 4-1 victory over Newcastle United in mid-September was the apex of that run and it appeared as though Daniel Farke could spearhead a top-half finish.

That was Leeds’ last win, with the club drawing three and losing two of the subsequent five matches. The panic button shouldn’t be pressed though, as Farke’s men currently sit 11th in the table and within touching distance of the top six.

While that might seem like a fantasy, this team have shown they can get results, even coming close to taking something off Arsenal a few weeks ago.
...
As such, Spurs shouldn’t be feared on Saturday lunchtime, although the North Londoners do have a decent record at this stadium in recent years.

The last time Leeds won at home in this fixture came back in May 2021. With Dominic Calvert-Lewin continuing his fine form from last term and Leeds having a solid defence, conceding just 0.9 goals per game, they will be tough to beat, that’s for sure.

### Spurs hitting form at precisely the right time

When Dominic Solanke scored a last minute winner against Manchester United on October 10, not many outside of North London thought much of it.

Instead, that goal has been the catalyst for the superb run of form Spurs have been on since, winning three successive games in the Premier League. Coventry, Chelsea and Crystal Palace have all been swatted aside, with De Zerbi’s men now sitting pretty in ninth, just four points outside the top four.

There is still plenty of work to be done, that much is certain, but the signs are good that the Italian has finally turned a corner. Jan Paul van Hecke and Micky van de Ven have formed a solid defensive partnership in recent games, while the likes of Sandro Tonali, Andrew Robertson and Mathys Tel have all improved over the previous few weeks.

Spurs have won at Elland Road on their previous three visits to Yorkshire and De Zerbi will be expecting another three points again this weekend.

### Team news

Noah Okafor and Anton Stach remain doubts for Farke, although the manager could include Joe Rodon in the matchday squad this weekend. Dominic Calvert-Lewin missed training during the week, but the striker should be fit for this clash.

Mykhaylo Mudryk, Xavi Simons and Wilson Odobert are all absent for Spurs while Tosin Adarabioyo and Lucas Bergvall remain doubts. Savio could make the squad having returned to training this week, but he might only be fit enough for an appearance from the bench.

### Prediction

This game could turn out to be a thriller, especially considering Spurs recent form in the top flight. Another victory for the away side will move them ever closer to the European spots, while Leeds could do with three points to move them closer from the drop zone.
...
It is hard to split these sides, so I’m going for a score draw. Leeds 1 – 1 Spurs.

Published November 4, 2026 12:46 PM

Roberto De Zerbi’s red-hot Tottenham Hotspur seek a fourth-straight win and a spot on the precipice of the top four when they visit Leeds United at Elland Road on Saturday.

Spurs have beaten Coventry City, Chelsea, and Crystal Palace by a combined 7-1 score line to go from 19th to ninth on the Premier League table.
...
Leeds have moved in the other direction after a five-match unbeaten run to start the league season, the last game of which has become the first of a five-match winless run.

Daniel Farke’s team has sandwiched losses to Arsenal and Bournemouth away around draws with Manchester United and Sunderland, and will be aching for three points that would send them above their Saturday visitors from their current 12th-place spot.

Below find start time, team news, how to watch info, and more for Leeds vs Spurs in Week 10 of the Premier League season.

## How to watch Leeds vs Tottenham Hotspur live, stream link and start time

Kick off time: 7:30am ET Saturday, November 4

Venue: Elland Road — Beeston, Leeds

TV Channel: USA

Stream link: Watch on USA

## Leeds vs Tottenham Hotspur team news

There are four notable ‘maybes’ to monitor in Leeds team news. Joe Rodon is a bit of a longshot but could feature, while Noah Okaford, Gabriel Gudmundsson, and James Justin have been odds of being available to face Spurs. Mateo Joseph remains out as he recovers from an ACL injury.

Spurs will hope to have Lucas Bergvall and Tosin Adarabioyo available but will certainly not have the suspended Rodrigo Bentancur. This will come too soon for Mykhailo Mudryk and Savio, while Xavi Simons and Wilson Odobert remain long-term absences.

## Leeds vs Tottenham Hotspur prediction

This is a bit of a toss-up in terms of the oddsmakers, made more even by the venue. It could go in any direction and both Farke and De Zerbi will have wrinkles for each other to sort in the first half. All told, though, we’re feeling Spurs’ momentum a bit too much. Leeds 0-1 Spurs.

Leeds host Tottenham in the Premier League on Saturday and Roberto De Zerbi's Spurs are chasing a fourth straight victory.

## Leeds vs Tottenham preview

After a rocky start to the season, Tottenham have won their last three Premier League matches and the omens are good for Saturday's trip to Elland Road.

Spurs won 4-0 at Leeds in February 2022 and triumphed 4-1 the following season before a 2-1 victory in West Yorkshire last term.

However, May's meeting at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium ended 1-1, helping to delay Spurs's escape from relegation until the final day, and the rivals could be hard to split this weekend.

Bookmakers are struggling to pick a favourite, which is understandable given Tottenham's improved results and Leeds's lean spell, and the draw is an eye-catching price.

Spurs were not playing disastrously during their six-match winless run at the start of the season.

Equally, though, punters should not get carried away by their recent success as they were strong favourites at home to Coventry, sealing a 3-1 win thanks to Ben Davies's 96th-minute goal.

Tottenham benefited from a goalkeeping error and Cole Palmer's red card in the 2-0 victory at Chelsea and beat Crystal Palace by the same scoreline after Jean-Philippe Mateta's early dismissal for the visitors.

De Zerbi's defence is shaping up well. World Cup-winning right-back Pedro Porro could return to the starting 11 and centre-halves Jan Paul van Hecke and Micky van de Ven should be confident of keeping Leeds's forwards quiet.

Daniel Farke's men turned on the style in September's 4-1 home win over Newcastle but they have scored only two goals in five subsequent matches.

They showed plenty of attacking endeavour in a 2-1 loss at champions Arsenal but 0-0 draws with Palace and Sunderland were disappointing.

Leeds also shared the points with struggling Manchester United at Elland Road in October and had only one shot on target in last weekend's 2-0 loss at Bournemouth.

Speedy Swiss forward Noah Okafor missed that game due to injury while influential defenders James Justin and Gabriel Gudmundsson picked up knocks.

Five of Leeds's last eight league games ended all-square and only Bournemouth had more Premier League draws than their tally of 14 last season.

Before the start of Tottenham's winning run, they had drawn three of their previous four matches including goalless stalemates with Nottingham Forest and Everton.

Spurs striker Dominic Solanke has scored only once in 444 minutes of league action and a lack of cutting edge could hamper both teams' chances of winning at Elland Road.

### Maddison magic may unlock home defence

James Maddison's return from long-term injury adds some vim and vigour to Tottenham's attack and he is worth backing to score or assist against Leeds.

Maddison opened the scoring in the win over his former club Coventry and he averages a goal or assist every 140 minutes during his league career at Spurs.

週六晚上，西甲第十二輪繼續展開角逐。馬拉加今季聯賽一勝難求，桑坦德聯賽客場表現極其糟糕，這場升班馬大戰注定難分難解，惡鬥成和較為合理。

時隔多年馬拉加今季重返西甲，無奈由於實力過分薄弱，11場聯賽戰罷錄得5和6負，導致他們難以脫離副班長位置，想提振士氣的辦法不多。爭勝力不濟主要體現在進攻端，全隊只有4人取得過聯賽入球，除了阿祖安.連奴貢獻5球較為搶眼，另外3人各入1球，可見球隊特別缺乏能幫手分擔破門壓力的人選。好的方面是，馬拉加近4場西甲都保持有入球，如果能在防守端有所改善，距離聯賽首勝應該不遠了。

同屬升班馬的桑坦德目前形勢比馬拉加稍為樂觀一些，前者以3勝2和6負積11分，未在降班漩渦內。但不得不說，桑坦德最大短板是防守很差，11場聯賽失29球，遠多於任何其他隊伍。最不利的是，桑坦德聯賽客場5戰全敗，均場失球多達3.6球，儼然是客場蟲。進攻端，桑坦德與馬拉加相似，過分依賴單一球員(Y.沙比利，聯賽入8球)，雖然其餘有7人貢獻聯賽入球但都只是1球，總的來說攻擊力不慍不火，所以今仗能以和局避免輸球的話已算有交代。

陣容方面

馬拉加：艾朗奧祖亞和祖倫.洛比迪等人傷缺；

桑坦德：A.文迪拿和安祖斯.馬田因傷免役。

# Torino and Lecce look to bounce back

Torino and Lecce are both aiming for all three points after recent defeats.

Both teams will be aiming to get back to winning ways and put their respective seasons back on track when Torino host Lecce at the Olimpico Grande Torino on Serie A Matchday 11. The Granata need to bounce back from defeats to Como and Frosinone, which ended a run of three consecutive victories. Lecce, four points further down the table, have lost their last three matches and are desperate to turn things around.

HEAD TO HEAD

There have been 17 previous competitive meetings between the two sides in Turin: 11 wins for Torino (most recently 1-0 in Serie A 2025/26), 4 draws (most recently 2-2 in Serie A 2024/25) and 2 wins for Lecce (most recently 2-1 in Serie A 2019/20).

Lecce have gone 428 minutes without scoring away to Torino: their last goal there was scored by Stępiński in the 22nd minute of Torino-Lecce 3-1 on 28 October 2020 in the Coppa Italia.

The meeting on 25 June 1989 at the Via del Mare was a historic one: on the final Matchday of Serie A 1988/89, in a situation very similar to the current one with both sides fighting for survival, Lecce won 3-1. Benedetti, Barbas and Paciocco scored for the hosts, while Fuser found the net for Torino. Lecce stayed up, while Torino were relegated to Serie B.

DID YOU KNOW?
...
Lecce have lost 3 consecutive matches: scoring 2 goals and conceding 9 over that run. Their last victory came on 18 October (Udinese-Lecce 0-3).

Lecce have conceded more first-half goals than any other team (13).

Lecce lose possession more often than any other team on average (78.4 times per match).

Only Cagliari (40.41%) and Parma (40.62%) have a lower average possession percentage than Lecce (42.07%).

COACHES and PLAYERS

This will be the 2nd official meeting between Ignazio Abate and Eusebio Di Francesco: the Lecce coach won their only previous encounter (Lecce-Juve Stabia 2-0, Coppa Italia 2025/26).

Youssef Maleh scored against Genoa: it was the Moroccan midfielder’s 1st goal of the season and his 4th overall in Serie A. His previous goal had come on 21 March (Parma-Cremonese 0-2, Serie A 2025/26).

sources.summary:
# 弗罗西诺内前锋比尔利贾：我们年轻、强大，能做成大事

弗罗西诺内无意停下脚步，前锋比尔利贾在周六做客卡利亚里前发出挑战。

“我们年轻、强大，能做成大事。”这名前布加勒斯特星队前锋为球队鼓劲。连续4场保持不败、并在斯蒂普球场豪取5连胜后，弗罗西诺内希望在客场也能延续状态，继续向积分榜前列迈进。这名罗马尼亚前锋是受伤的拉蒙多的主要接班人候选，他准备不让这位意甲副射手王留下空缺：拼劲、奔跑和牺牲精神，是他应对卡利亚里防线的武器。

至于对手可能采取的限制办法，他也毫不担心：“他们才该担心，因为我们状态正好。”谈到这场与卡利亚里的比赛，他很明确：“肯定会很难，但我们必须保持专注。赛季开局非常不错，我们想沿着这条路继续走下去。不管谁首发，谁替补登场，我们都要成为一个整体，就像每次进球后我们都会一起拥抱那样。”比尔利贾已经在5场比赛里用93分钟打进2球，状态正热。

“我之前就说过，我是那种拼尽全力的球员，”这名前锋补充道，“我会拼抢，也会和对手硬碰硬。我已经准备好面对一切。我从小就只想着进球，小时候我就站在球门前，再也没有离开过。后来我明白，前锋也要为球队工作，要护球，诸如此类。幸运的是，我也有不错的身体素质，所以还能利用速度冲击身后空间。”这名罗马尼亚中锋并不担心随着赛季推进，对手会逐渐研究出应对办法。

“我们有自己的踢法，效果很好，我们会继续这么踢，”比尔利贾强调，“如果我们踢得这么好，为什么要改变？该害怕的是对手，他们得想办法做出不同的应对。”

卡利亚里之行，弗罗西诺内会带着高涨的士气和令人意外的第6名、20分出发。主帅阿尔维尼相较于战胜弗罗西诺内那场比赛不会做太多调整。防线上，右后卫奥约诺有望回归，中卫位置则依旧在蒙特里西和奇塔迪尼之间竞争。正如前文所说，锋线中路比尔利贾替代拉蒙多时，领先于博布塞克。格里利奇仍将缺席。

# 德甲：RB萊比錫vs奧格斯堡預測分析 主場不失球遇考驗

看球老登 2026-11-06 19:54

2026-2027賽季德甲聯賽第9輪將在11月7日展開，RB萊比錫坐鎮主場迎戰奧格斯堡。8輪聯賽踢完，萊比錫拿到5場勝利、3場失利，沒有平局，15分讓球隊排在第4位，進22球、失11球；奧格斯堡交出2勝3平3負，9分排在第10位，進18球、失15球，兩隊之間相差6分。

聯賽至今，萊比錫場均進球2.8個、場均失球1.4個。主場4戰全部取勝，打進18球且失球數爲0，主場戰績排在第1。最近6場德甲主場，萊比錫保持全勝，進23球僅失2球；最近6場德甲整體是4勝2負，進18球失8球。歐冠最近一戰面對曼城，萊比錫從0-1落後開始追趕，第49分鐘巴庫在格魯達助攻下扳平，第61分鐘努薩接恩昆庫傳球將比分改寫成2-2，但終場仍以2-3告負；該場控球率36%，射正6次，角球5次。

上一場萊比錫擺出4-3-3，後防由巴庫、奧爾班、盧克巴、勞姆4人組成，努薩、格魯達和羅慕洛出現在前場，這一結構本場有繼續沿用可能。努薩在聯賽中已有4球6助攻入賬，射正9次；戈米完成21次射門。9月14日，阿桑·韋德拉奧果遭遇肩部傷；同一天，馬克·吉烏遭遇腿筋傷；11月3日，馬克斯·芬克格雷夫遭遇未知傷情。

奧格斯堡聯賽場均進球是2.3個，場均失球1.9個；客場戰績爲1勝2負，進9球失8球。最近6場德甲，球隊3平3負未嘗勝績，進11球失14球；最近6場德甲客場拿到3勝3負，進14球失14球。上一場主場迎戰弗賴堡，格雷戈裏奇第18分鐘接伊布拉希莫維奇傳球先開紀錄，然而第65分鐘和第85分鐘連續失球，比分最終定格在1-2，奧格斯堡被逆轉；該場控球率55%，射正5次，角球1次。

格雷戈裏奇聯賽已進5球，22次射門裏有15次打在門框範圍內，他在奧格斯堡進攻端承擔最直接終結任務；裏德送出4次助攻。上一場奧格斯堡以3-4-2-1出戰，格雷戈裏奇頂在最前，伊布拉希莫維奇在其身後提供支援。後防線輪換空間被壓縮。朱馬·巴停賽，卡爾文·布拉克爾曼在10月25日遭遇腦震盪，諾亞凱·班克斯在10月8日遭遇膝關節傷。

雙方最近6次聯賽交手，萊比錫4勝2平，進17球失3球。萊比錫聯賽主場4場過後仍未丟球，奧格斯堡最近6場德甲客場收穫14個進球、丟掉14球，格雷戈裏奇能否在客場攻破萊比錫聯賽主場至今未失球球門？

# 莱比锡主场迎战奥格斯堡，德米凯利斯压力下争胜
...
- 莱比锡积15分排第四，主场联赛尚未失球
- 奥格斯堡六轮不胜，积9分排第十
- 莱比锡吉乌伤缺，努萨出战成疑

德甲联赛周六将迎来莱比锡主场对阵奥格斯堡的比赛。莱比锡目前积15分排名第四，落后多特蒙德和榜首拜仁慕尼黑3分；奥格斯堡则积9分排名第十，仅比降级附加赛区的柏林联合高出2分，且与第15名汉堡同分。

莱比锡在周中欧冠2比3不敌曼城，三连胜被终结，这也是他们本赛季首次在主场丢球。不过在国内联赛中，莱比锡在红牛竞技场保持零失球，本赛季德甲已打入22球，仅次于拜仁。若本周末取胜，将是德米凯利斯执教下近5场比赛的第4场胜利，甚至可能追平多特蒙德和拜仁的积分。

德米凯利斯近期受到德国媒体的猛烈批评，其帅位受到直接质疑。对此他表示，如果无法实现俱乐部目标，他将在赛季结束后主动离开。前莱比锡主帅、现执教伯恩茅斯的罗泽也谈到德米凯利斯承受的压力：“如果你对媒体环境有所了解，你 already 能感觉到风向是负面的。”罗泽还透露，自己在红牛竞技场的执教生涯结束对他“有所触动”，让他失去了一些“轻松感”。

奥格斯堡本赛季以两连胜开局，但此后在德甲陷入六轮不胜，期间3负3平。他们上一次联赛取胜是9月6日4比1大胜法兰克福。这段低迷期唯一的亮点是德国杯4比2战胜格罗斯阿斯帕赫，但四天后便在WWK竞技场1比2不敌弗赖堡。不过，奥格斯堡本赛季各项赛事四场胜利中有三场来自客场。

伤病方面，莱比锡前锋吉乌继续因腿筋伤势缺阵，边锋努萨在對曼城一役中因预防措施被换下，出战成疑。德米凯利斯表示：“他当时接近受伤。如果我没有换下他，我们显然会失去他六周。”若努萨无法出场，戈米斯可能顶替其位置。左后卫芬克格雷费因大腿问题存疑，中场奥埃德拉奥戈仍因肩伤缺阵。预计劳姆出任左后卫，埃尔阿纳维和赖茨搭档双后腰。

奥格斯堡后防线人手紧张，中卫班克斯（膝伤）、布拉克尔曼（脑震荡）和巴（停赛）均无法出场。鲍姆可能安排古韦莱乌、凯特尔和马齐马组成三中卫，费尔豪尔和贝伦斯担任翼卫。

莱比锡预计首发：范德沃特；亨里希斯、奥尔班、卢克巴、劳姆；埃尔阿纳维、赖茨；戈米斯、恩昆库、努萨；罗慕洛。奥格斯堡预计首发：达门；古韦莱乌、凯特尔、马齐马；费尔豪尔、马桑戈、里德尔、贝伦斯；卡德、伊布拉希莫维奇；格雷戈里奇。

本文根据Sports Mole的报道《RB Leipzig vs Augsburg - prediction, team news, lineups》编译整理。

# 法兰克福客战帕德博恩，许特尔旧地未曾取胜

法兰克福希望延续一周内两度以3:1击败汉堡的势头，用对阵帕德博恩和霍芬海姆的胜利向上靠拢。周六球队将客场挑战帕德博恩，这支升班马本赛季开局缓慢，目前排在第14位。原文将帕德博恩称为难缠的对手，但认为这并非不可能完成的任务。

周三中午法兰克福训练时天气寒冷，但气氛并不冷清。一周内两胜汉堡似乎让球队完成转折，创纪录首秀的尼科-伊利切维奇获得出场机会，前队长大卫-亚伯拉罕当天也在法兰克福逗留并观看了训练。对阵汉堡这一周是否真的带来转折，将在未来几周见分晓。

打完帕德博恩后，霍芬海姆将做客法兰克福，他们本赛季的步子同样不算太稳。若能取得两场胜利，法兰克福就可以为跻身积分榜上三分之一奠定方向，之后球队将客场挑战斯图加特。

法兰克福在帕德博恩还从未赢过，三次做客全部告负，最近一次是2019年的1:2，当时的主帅是许特尔。伊利切维奇当时才九岁。

国家队比赛间歇期同样值得关注。最近国家队的双前锋是乔纳森-布尔卡德和埃布努塔利布，国家队中出现纯法兰克福锋线组合，这在之前52年未曾有过，当年的组合是贝恩德-赫尔岑拜因和于尔根-格拉博夫斯基。国家队主帅于尔根-克洛普在最初几场比赛中也做了很多尝试，他是否会在对阵塞尔维亚和荷兰时再次同时征召两名法兰克福前锋尚待观察。

训练中两名前锋都在进球。布尔卡德在射门训练中用外脚背把球击中门柱后弹入左上角，笑得合不拢嘴。伊利切维奇在16岁零一天时对阵汉堡完成德甲首秀，并直接借此为自己做了宣传。他在训练中表现不俗，看起来和对阵汉堡时一样：勇敢、强壮、无所畏惧，并且拥有非凡的能力。法兰克福希望谨慎培养他，一步一步促进他的发展，但鉴于他的能力，给他出场机会似乎也是好主意，也许就在帕德博恩。

# 德甲：帕德博恩vs法兰克福预测分析 主场稳守与锋线火力之争

数据拆解师 2026-11-06 20:00

11月7日，德甲联赛第9轮帕德博恩将在主场迎战法兰克福。赛前积分榜上，帕德博恩9分排第14位，法兰克福11分排第8位，2分差距使这场对话保留悬念。

近6场各项赛事，帕德博恩取得2胜2平2负，进4球失5球；联赛8轮过后2胜3平3负，进6球失9球，其中主场4场2胜0平2负，进4球失4球。上一场做客门兴，双方0比0收场，帕德博恩控球率57%、角球7比4、射正4比4，场面有控制力，临门一脚还差一点意思。蒂格斯联赛打进2球，17次射门、5次射正在队内最高，施蒂克送出1次助攻。马塞尔·霍夫迈尔在8月30日遭遇肌肉挫伤，尼亚梅基·阿沃特维-格兰特在7月15日遭遇膝关节伤，蒂穆尔·盖雷特在4月21日遭遇膝关节伤。上一场排出3-1-4-2，本场预计仍会以3中卫体系应对。

法兰克福上一场在主场3比1拿下汉堡，恩瓦迪克第47分钟破门，埃布努塔利布第69分钟接乌尊助攻得分，全场射正10比3。联赛前8轮，法兰克福3胜2平3负，进13球失18球，客场4场1胜1平2负，进6球失11球；近6场各项赛事为4胜0平2负，进11球失9球。埃布努塔利布以6球领跑队内射手榜，21次射门、11次射正在队内最高，阿塞科送出1次助攻。马里奥·格策11月2日出现伤情，具体情况尚未明确；杰西克·恩甘卡姆5月5日遭遇腿筋伤。上一场以4-2-3-1出战，本场预计沿用这一阵型。

联赛至今，法兰克福场均射正6次，帕德博恩为3.5次；进球转化率11.7%对5.4%，快攻转化率18.2%对11.1%，客队射门转化进球效率更高。帕德博恩场均失1.1球，有效阻挡32次、解围276次，法兰克福这两项分别为24次和269次，主队更依赖防守层次与中场控制来寻找破局。法兰克福联赛客场场均失2.75球，防线保护会直接影响比赛风险。

帕德博恩主场4场2胜0平2负，法兰克福近6场4胜且埃布努塔利布联赛已有6球入账。主队需要提高联赛至今5.4%进球转化率，客队要面对联赛客场场均失2.75球这一现实。稳守反击遇上锋线火力，帕德博恩能否把对门兴时那种控制转化为进球，法兰克福又能否延续上一场打进3球势头？

# 瓦格纳：埃尔沃斯贝格要勇敢进攻多特蒙德

约8000名埃尔沃斯贝格球迷将在周六随队前往多特蒙德，这是该俱乐部历史上客场随队球迷人数最多的一次，这一纪录将在德国最大的足球场诞生。北京时间11月7日22:30（当地时间15点30分），埃尔沃斯贝格将在客场对阵多特蒙德。

埃尔沃斯贝格带着上升势头而来。八轮德甲过后，文森特-瓦格纳执教的球队以13分排名第七，最近一轮主场4:1战胜美因茨05。瓦格纳认为，这场胜利是球队在一周双赛中三场踢得漂亮的比赛所换来的回报。

国际比赛日间歇期前，埃尔沃斯贝格将面对联赛迄今最好的防线。多特蒙德仅失六球，与榜首拜仁慕尼黑同分，排名第二。尽管如此，瓦格纳仍打算对多特蒙德采取进攻打法，他的要求是：“勇敢、有吸引力、进攻！同时防守稳固。”

自上一个国际比赛日间歇期以来，多特蒙德已经踢了八场正式比赛。瓦格纳并不认为这对埃尔沃斯贝格构成决定性优势，他表示尼科-科瓦奇的球队习惯了密集赛程，阵容厚度充足，并且可以依靠主场球迷的支持。

埃尔沃斯贝格方面，近期有伤在身的球员中哪些能在周六前恢复，目前仍不确定。瓦格纳表示在决定阵容时会谨慎行事，并希望在国际比赛日间歇期后能重新使用完整阵容。

11月7日，2026-2027賽季德甲第9輪，多特蒙德主場迎戰埃爾沃斯貝格。8輪過後，主隊5勝3平0負拿到18分，排第2，進14球失6球；客隊4勝1平3負，13分排第7，16個進球、16個失球。兩隊相差5分，主隊要延續不敗走勢，客隊希望把上一輪4比1勢頭帶到客場。

多特蒙德最近6場各項賽事4勝2平，10個進球、6個失球。歐冠主場面對貝蒂斯，上半場0比0僵持，下半場第49分鐘席爾瓦先拔頭籌，第67分鐘魯伊瓦爾追平比分，第72分鐘卡雷薩斯接席爾瓦傳球完成制勝一擊，比分2比1。範圍縮到德甲，近6輪3勝3平，9個進球、4個失球，其中聯賽主場4戰3勝1平，8個進球、2個失球。上一場歐冠多特以3-4-2-1開局。

# 德甲前瞻：拜仁续约凯恩后还有大喜讯？美因茨客场强势主场拉胯！

北京时间11月7日22时30分，德甲联赛第9轮，拜仁慕尼黑将客场挑战美因茨。美因茨本赛季客场表现出色，但主场战绩糟糕；拜仁近期状态不错，赛前续约金球先生凯恩，顶替养病主帅的助教丹克斯也获得高层认可。

美因茨近况

美因茨近期状态不佳，过去2轮德甲，球队先后不敌云达不莱梅、埃尔沃斯贝格，算上德国杯第二轮不敌波鸿一战，美因茨10月下旬的3场比赛遭遇三连败。

本赛季美因茨状态起伏不定，德国媒体指出：“这主要是因为美因茨主客场的战术打法、成绩存在很大区别。”德甲前8轮，美因茨主场4战1平3负未尝胜绩，打入6球失10球，在“主场积分榜”上排在倒数第一；客场4战则是3胜1负，打入11球失7球，在“客场积分榜”上排在第一，甚至比4个客场拿到8分的拜仁、多特蒙德更高。本轮又轮到美因茨主场作战，球队希望一扫主场颓势。

赛前美因茨主帅、队长均表示，球队过去一周做了很多工作，希望扭转连败势头。队长维德默指出：“连败的感觉很糟糕，这会让球队失去自信，产生自我怀疑。应对之策是什么？是深入复盘分析、内部坦诚交流。所有球员直面彼此，用清晰、直接的沟通，共同表示要专注于球队最核心、最重要的品质：团队精神。”

主帅费舍尔表示：“三连败之后又对上拜仁这样的强敌，感觉如何？说实话，对手是谁并不重要，我们很清楚，想要对阵拜仁时取得佳绩，球队必须拿出最好的表现。无论如何，现在最重要的是，球队必须找回核心优势：团结、协作、坚定的信念、昂扬的斗志。”

拜仁近况

拜仁近期状态不错。10月18日以来，拜仁连续对阵多支强敌，赛程难度极大。不过拜仁6-1击败莱比锡，2-2战平阿森纳、多特蒙德，周中欧冠则是客场2-0完胜马竞，整体表现符合舆论界的预期。

赛前拜仁获得了不少喜讯，较为重要的是两个。首先，拜仁成功续约了刚刚荣膺金球奖的头号球星凯恩。球队高管埃贝尔表示：“拜仁能留住世界最佳球员，这本身就是一份强有力的宣言，告诉全世界，拜仁志在争夺最重磅的冠军，会努力变得更加强大。”转会专家罗马诺介绍，拜仁在完成凯恩续约后，又迅速开启了奥利塞的续约谈判，这些操作将提振核心球员的士气与求战欲望。

其二，在孔帕尼晕倒在训练场后，拜仁要求主帅安心在家养病，让助教丹克斯带队比赛。丹克斯带队4场，率队击败弗莱堡、马格德堡、马竞，战平多特蒙德，战绩出色。拜仁球迷纷纷打趣：“孔帕尼一开始是担心‘球队没我不行’，现在他需要担心‘球队没我也行’了。”

赛前拜仁CEO德雷森表示：“我们必须感谢亚伦（丹克斯），他在困难时期接手了这份工作。我们也要感谢文森特（孔帕尼），他干得很出色，他的团队同样很出色！”

交锋纪录

根据德转数据，两队自1999年至今的27年里，合计44次交锋，拜仁32胜4平8负，进130球丢52球。

伤停情况

根据《图片报》的介绍，拜仁的塞巴里、恩迪亚耶、迪亚斯等人受到伤病困扰，无法出场；穆西亚拉刚刚伤愈回归训练，是否具备出场条件有待临场评估。美因茨后卫波施上轮染红，本场停赛；姆韦内也将因为累计黄牌停赛；中场鲁皮和前锋西拉斯等人受伤病困扰，能否出场存疑。

# Mainz 05 vs Bayern Munich football prediction in Bundesliga

An An - 17:08, Fri Nov 06, 2026 (GMT+7)

Football prediction for the Mainz 05 - Bayern Munich match within the framework of round 9 of the 2026-2027 Bundesliga season.

Overview

Bayern Munich will have a guest match at Mainz's stadium in the Bundesliga with the goal of winning all three points to consolidate the top spot. While the away team is maintaining an unbeaten record and possessing an effective attack, Mainz is falling into a serious decline, especially when they do not know the victory at home this season.

Mainz is going through a disappointing streak of losing four of their last five matches in all competitions, including three defeats in the last four rounds of the Bundesliga.

The 1-4 defeat to Elversberg exposed many problems in the playing style of the team led by coach Fischer. Mainz was led 3-0 by the opponent in the first half and conceded a fourth goal before scoring a consolation goal in the final minutes of injury time.

This result certainly makes Fischer worried, especially when Mainz has not yet created stability after the early stages of the season. This team is currently ranked ninth in the standings, but the gap with Union Berlin in 16th place, relegation play-off spot, is only three points. Some unfavorable results may cause Mainz to quickly be pulled down to the bottom of the table.

The upcoming schedule also does not favor the MEWA Arena team. In the next seven Bundesliga rounds, they will successively face all four leading teams. In the immediate future, the reception of Bayern is already a very big challenge for a team that is lacking confidence.

Home record makes Mainz fans even more worried. This team has not won any match at MEWA Arena this season, only winning one point after four home games against opponents. If they continue to lose to Bayern, Mainz will suffer their fourth consecutive home defeat.

In the opposite direction, Bayern is still leading the Bundesliga and maintains an unbeaten record in the last eight matches in all competitions. However, Vincent Kompany's team has started to drop more points than in the early season. The 2-2 draw against Borussia Dortmund is the latest example.

In the great battle at Allianz Arena, Bayern twice took the lead but could not maintain the advantage. Dortmund's equalizer in the 89th minute forced the home team to accept a draw. This is also Bayern's second draw in the last four rounds of the Bundesliga, although they still maintained the leading position.

In all competitions, Bayern has drawn four in the last eight matches. However, those results do not overshadow the strength of the Bavarian team. In the middle of the week, they defeated Atletico Madrid with a score of 2-0 in the Champions League, continuing to maintain stable form in the European arena.

This is Bayern's eighth away match this season and their fifth victory in away trips. Kompany's team scored at least two goals in seven of those eight matches.

However, the defensive ability when playing away from Allianz Arena still has points to improve, because the victory against Atletico is the second time Bayern has kept a clean sheet away from home this season.

Personnel situation

The home team does not have the service of Dominik Kohr and Stefan Posch. Posch must serve a suspension after receiving a red card in the defeat to Elversberg.

The away team also suffered some personnel losses. Luis Diaz and Serge Gnabry are definitely absent due to hamstring injuries, while Jamal Musiala's ability to play is still undetermined.

However, Harry Kane is still an irreplaceable choice in attack. The English striker will aim for his fifth goal in the Bundesliga this season after just extending his contract with Bayern.

The match between Mainz 05 and Bayern Munich takes place at 9:30 PM on November 7th (Vietnam time).

# 英超前瞻：升班马杀手？阿森纳能否拿下胜利？赫尔城近7轮平5场！

北京时间11月7日23时，英超联赛第10轮，阿森纳将坐镇主场迎战赫尔城。阿森纳本赛季主场的联赛、欧冠比赛取得全胜，球队非常擅长应对升班马；赫尔城联赛连胜开局后，近7轮打平5场，是联赛平局最多的球队之一。

阿森纳近况

阿森纳近期状态出色，过去一周，球队先是在联赛1-0击败利物浦，随后在欧冠客场2-1击败布拉格斯拉维亚。枪手在英超以3分优势领跑积分榜；欧冠4战拿到10分，排名联赛阶段积分榜第3。阿森纳的主场状态尤其出色，本赛季联赛、欧冠双线主场赛事取得全胜。

赛前英超官网强调纪录：阿森纳与赫尔城上一次在英超交锋是2016-17赛季，那个赛季枪手主客场双杀“老虎城”。阿森纳非常擅长迎战升班马，最近19次联赛对阵新升级球队，枪手取得18胜1平的不败战绩，上一次阿森纳输给当赛季的升班马是2023年5月不敌诺丁汉森林。如果只看主场的话，阿森纳最近17次主场对阵当赛季的升班马取得17连胜。

赛前阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔表示：“我承认周中欧冠我们虽然2-1击败布拉格斯拉维亚，但表现并不好。上半场我们的水平非常高，但下半场的表现、战术执行都远低于正常水准。这是一次深刻的教训。不可否认的是，我们短期内踢了连续三个客场——尽管这不能成为我们的借口。回到主场比赛，这将对我们很有帮助。”

赫尔城近况

赫尔城上赛季排名英冠第六，但在升级附加赛中一路过关斩将，成功实现升级。赛季前赫尔城表示球队目标是保级，目前排名联赛第11位的成绩高于预期。

联赛前两轮，赫尔城取得两连胜，随后7轮赫尔城打平5场，先后战平阿斯顿维拉、切尔西、埃弗顿、布伦特福德和伊普斯维奇。英国媒体指出：“赫尔城表现出‘遇强不弱’的特点，球队本赛季首轮就2-0击败曼联，也有过逼和维拉、切尔西的表现。打法方面，赫尔城有很强的跑动、逼抢能力，擅长利用定位球，这让球队有能力与强队周旋。”

赛前赫尔城主帅雅基罗维奇表示：“这场比赛是赫尔城历史上第200场英超比赛？是的，俱乐部上下非常自豪，200场可不是一个小数目！我们都清楚，想在英超站稳脚跟有多么困难。近期我看了很多阿森纳的比赛录像，想要在对阵他们时找到突破口，但他们真的太出色了。在我看来，阿森纳实力极强，他们和巴黎圣日耳曼处于同一档次。我们必须保持阵型紧凑，必须收缩防守、强硬对抗，并抓住断球的机会打反击。特别重要的是在定位球防守方面保持高度专注，绝对不能犯错！”

交锋纪录

赫尔城此前一共踢了199场英超比赛，其中10场是对阵阿森纳，赫尔城1胜1平8负。根据德转数据，再算上两队在英联杯、足总杯的8次交锋，赫尔城18场对阵枪手的总成绩是1胜2平15负，进13球失46球。

伤停情况

阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔透露，在周中欧冠赛事里因伤被换下的孔萨能否出场存疑。赫尔城方面，门将巴特兰（肘关节受伤）、中场马塔佐（十字韧带伤）、中卫休斯（疝气）、中场吉亚比（腹股沟伤）等人受到伤病困扰。

# 阿森纳对阵赫尔城的比赛前瞻与预测：枪手巩固榜首位置。

英超联赛第 10 轮阿森纳对阵赫尔城的比赛前瞻及比分预测，比赛将于 11 月 7 日 22:00 举行。

比赛前瞻：阿森纳对阵赫尔城，11月7日22:00。
...
阿森纳将在英超联赛第十轮坐镇酋长球场迎战赫尔城。在战胜利物浦的关键胜利之后，枪手有机会巩固榜首位置，而他们的对手目前正遭遇七场不胜。然而，赫尔城依然是一支难缠的对手，他们风格顽强，而且自赛季开始以来平局较多。

阿森纳在上一轮客场1-0战胜利物浦后信心满满地进入本场比赛。这场胜利对阿尔特塔的球队意义重大，不仅因为它终结了球队在安菲尔德球场的长期不胜纪录，更重要的是，它帮助球队巩固了在冠军争夺战中的领先优势。目前，阿森纳在9轮过后积24分，领先曼城3分，在争夺榜首的道路上占据着有利位置。

阿森纳不仅在英超联赛中取得了不错的成绩，而且在多项赛事中也保持了相当稳定的发挥。周中，这支伦敦球队在欧冠联赛中以2-1战胜布拉格斯拉维亚，延续了他们的连胜势头。尽管赛程密集，枪手们依然展现出了掌控比赛的能力，并在关键时刻保持了冷静。回到酋长球场，他们的目标无疑是拿下三分，以阻止竞争对手追赶。

在比赛风格方面，阿森纳展现出了控球和防守组织之间的平衡。德克兰·赖斯凭借其出色的抢断能力、积极的拼抢和对比赛节奏的掌控，继续在中场扮演着至关重要的角色。马丁·厄德高在中路进攻配合中展现出了创造力，而诺尼·马杜埃克则凭借其速度和盘带能力在边路创造了突破机会。此外，在攻入制胜球击败利物浦后，凯·哈弗茨也是进攻端值得关注的选择。

然而，阿森纳在对阵赫尔城的比赛前仍面临一些阵容问题。布卡约·萨卡仍在从腿筋伤势中恢复，预计短期内无法复出。马克斯·道曼也因停赛缺阵，而埃兹里·孔萨在对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的比赛中受伤，能否出战尚不确定。

另一方面，赫尔城自联赛开局以来就陷入了困境。在战胜曼联和考文垂之后，塞尔吉·雅基罗维奇的球队未能保持住势头，在英超联赛中已经连续七轮不胜。在最近一轮比赛中，赫尔城与伊普斯维奇战成2-2平，尽管他们控球不佳，给了对手很多机会。九轮过后，客队积11分，目前排名积分榜第11位。

值得注意的是，尽管赫尔城状态起伏不定，但他们并非易于战胜。自赛季开始以来，他们已经取得了五场平局，这展现了他们掌控比赛节奏和顶住对手压力的能力，即使面对实力更强的对手也能保持优势。穆罕默德·贝卢米是球队进攻端的一名重要球员，他速度快、盘带能力强，经常在边路制造威胁。与此同时，奥利·麦克伯尼凭借其强壮的身体和在禁区内抢断的能力，为球队提供了直接的进攻选择。

然而，赫尔城将面临严峻的人员挑战。马特·克鲁克斯因累积黄牌停赛，而埃利奥特·马塔佐、马特·塔格特、卢卡斯·古尔纳-杜阿特、伊利亚斯·安萨、达尔科·吉亚比和查理·休斯均因伤缺阵。杰克·巴特兰德有望在手臂伤愈后复出，但客队仍然缺少几名关键球员。这可能会让主教练雅基罗维奇难以排出一支能够抵挡阿森纳压力的阵容。

从历史战绩来看，阿森纳对赫尔城占据明显优势。在双方10次英超交锋中，枪手取得了8胜1平1负的战绩。值得一提的是，这支伦敦球队在最近9次交锋中保持不败，包括在2017年2月的最近一次交锋...

# 赫尔城主帅：客场挑战阿森纳必须尽快进入状态

赫尔城上轮在MKM球场2-2战平伊普斯维奇，赛季第五场平局后积分达到11分。上半场球队表现糟糕，中场休息变阵4-3-3后才扭转局面，由伊罗格布南和麦克布涅先后破门，一度2-1领先，但最终被恩西索扳平。

这是赫尔城连续第三个主场在取得领先的情况下未能全取三分。球队九场比赛输了两场，主场保持不败，位居英超中游。

亚基罗维奇在赛前表示，他手上有27名健康球员，无法把所有人列入比赛日名单。索尔巴-托马斯、古尔纳-杜瓦特和已经伤愈的巴特兰都没有进入上轮大名单；查利-休斯和安萨也即将回归，需要在训练场上证明自己的价值。

赫尔城本赛季在切尔西、纽卡斯尔、富勒姆以及上轮对伊普斯维奇的开局都不理想，多次因开局被动而陷入困境。亚基罗维奇希望球队客场挑战阿森纳时开局良好，不要让对手早早杀死比赛。

阿森纳本赛季已经有过几次动摇，均出现在客场，分别是对布莱顿和周二对弗利特伍德。赫尔城方面认为，全队会带着信念前往客场，争取在冠军球队状态不佳的一天拿到积极结果。

# 英超：阿森納vs赫爾城預測分析 主場全勝遇平局怪圈

數據拆解師 2026-11-06 20:05

本次帶來2026-2027賽季英超第10輪一場較量，11月7日阿森納在主場迎戰赫爾城。前9輪結束，阿森納8勝0平1負拿到24分，排名第1；赫爾城2勝5平2負收穫11分，排名第11位。積分差距讓這場比賽在賽前有明確強弱背景，不過赫爾城近期平局不少，比賽未必會順着排名走。

9輪聯賽打完，阿森納打入14球、丟掉5球，場均進球1.6個、失球0.6個；主場4場全部取勝，9個進球、2個失球。最近6場各項賽事4勝2平，上一場歐冠客場2-1擊敗布拉格斯拉維亞，第9分鐘馬杜埃凱接到哲凱賴什助攻先拔頭籌，第38分鐘哲凱賴什又借梅里諾助攻擴大優勢。哈弗茨在聯賽已有3球入賬，薩卡17次射門、10次射正，賴斯送出5次助攻。11月5日，孔薩遭遇傷情，具體情況尚未明確；10月22日，薩卡遭遇傷情，具體情況尚未明確；道曼因停賽缺席。主教練有可能繼續使用4-2-3-1，聯賽59%控球率與85.8%傳球成功率是陣型延續依據。

上一場在主場面對伊普斯維奇，赫爾城第58分鐘由伊羅格布南接到麥克伯尼助攻將比分扳平，第68分鐘麥克伯尼利用任意球完成反超，第74分鐘恩西索把比分追成2-2。聯賽前9輪，赫爾城進11球、失10球，場均進球1.2個、失球1.1個；客場1勝1平2負，最近6場英超0勝4平2負。貝魯米在聯賽打進3球，23次射門、6次射正，另有2次助攻。克魯克斯停賽；10月10日，杜阿斯遭遇傷情，具體情況尚未明確；9月13日，塔格特遭遇踝關節傷；8月4日，加比遭遇腹股溝傷；4月26日，瑪塔佐遭遇膝關節損傷，預計2027年3月8日結束。上一場主教練排出5-4-1，本場存在繼續壓縮空間可能，聯賽33%控球率和256次解圍是判斷依據。

聯賽場均控球率59%、場均角球5.6次，阿森納球權和定位球機會更多；赫爾城對應數據爲33%和4.1次。傳中成功率26.8%、長傳成功率41.5%，阿森納這兩項高於赫爾城20.1%和37%，主隊更可能從穩定中場控制與邊路傳中展開進攻；赫爾城若想找到反擊空間，需要把5-4-1防守層次站住，並藉助貝魯米個人衝擊。阿森納前場傷情尚未明朗，輪換可能波及臨門一腳穩定性；赫爾城中場多人傷停，客場出球壓力不小。

最近6次碰面，阿森納5勝1平。聯賽主場4場全勝，9個進球、2個失球；赫爾城最近6場英超0勝4平2負。密集防守能把比賽拖成僵局嗎？赫爾城能否把平局怪圈延續到客場？

## 阿森納vs赫爾城勝平負預測

球迷屋對本場比賽給出勝平負預測：阿森納勝率59%，平率32%，赫爾城勝率9%。

# 英超富勒姆对纽卡斯尔的比赛分析

Diệu Anh - 19:59, Fri Nov 06, 2026 (GMT+7)

2026-2027赛季英超联赛第10轮富勒姆-纽卡斯尔比赛的足球评论。

总览

富勒姆在英超联赛艰难开局后,状态逐渐好转。 从经历了前六轮不胜,阿尔瓦罗·阿尔贝罗亚教练的球队已经连续三场不败,并且在最近的六轮中只输了一场。

在克拉文农场迎战纽卡斯尔联队,富勒姆有机会延续对阵同样状态不佳的对手的良好战绩。

在以1-0的比分连续战胜赫尔城和考文垂城之后,富勒姆在最近一轮客场对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中又获得了一分。

阿尔贝罗亚对他的弟子们越来越相信他所建立的比赛方式感到满意。富勒姆目前在积分榜上排名第15位,仅比降级区高出两分。这位教练希望球队在接下来的道路上继续进步,从而尽快与积分榜末尾的球队拉开安全距离。

富勒姆最大的亮点在于后防线。尽管只进了九个球,属于联赛进攻成绩最差的三支球队之列,但他们在最近的六轮比赛中只丢了三个球。在八支垫底球队中,没有俱乐部的防守成绩比富勒姆更好,本赛季至今总共丢了11个球。

交锋历史也给主队带来了信心。富勒姆在最近四次对阵纽卡斯尔的英超比赛中赢了三场,只输了一场。在此之前,他们曾连续八次不胜英格兰东北部的对手,两场平局,六场失利。

虽然富勒姆正在找回稳定,但纽卡斯尔在马蒂亚斯·贾斯勒执教下却陷入了困境。这支球队充满希望的开局现在已经成为球迷们遥不可及的记忆。

在圣詹姆斯公园以0-1输给埃弗顿,让球迷们难掩失望之情。纽卡斯尔在最近五场比赛中遭遇第四场失利后,看台上响起了嘘声。

这也是纽卡斯尔在短短五天内第二次输给埃弗顿。此前,他们在对阵对手的比赛中以1-3落败,被淘汰出卡拉宝杯第四轮。

尽管如此,贾斯尔坚称他并不担心“喜鹊”的衰落。这位德国教练上周也感受到了来自管理层的更大支持。然而,纽卡斯尔需要尽快找回胜利,否则不想卷入积分榜下半区的战斗。

客队目前排名第13位,仅比排名倒数第三的球队多四分。 在客场对阵富勒姆之后,他们将面临艰难的赛程,在11月国家队集训后将与阿森纳、布莱顿、曼联和桑德兰交锋。

纽卡斯尔可能会从客场战绩中找到鼓励。他们在最近一次英超联赛的客场之旅中以2-0击败了水晶宫,并正朝着自2025年4月以来首次在客场取得两连胜的目标迈进。值得注意的是,纽卡斯尔最近四次在联赛中的客场胜利都发生在伦敦。

人事情况

富勒姆队在这场比赛中几乎拥有完整的阵容。瑞恩·塞塞尼翁在停赛三场后复出,并可能与安东尼·罗宾逊竞争左后卫的位置。

纽卡斯尔遭受重大损失,乔林顿在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中受伤,而雅各布·拉姆塞因吃到红牌被停赛一场。蒂诺·利夫拉门托和伊万·贾温继续因伤缺阵。马蒂亚斯·费尔南德斯-帕尔多和刘易斯·迈利也需要在比赛开始前进行检查。

富勒姆和纽卡斯尔之间的比赛于越南时间 11 月 7 日 22:00 举行。

# Fulham vs Newcastle Premier League Match Preview

Diệu Anh - 19:59, Fri Nov 06, 2026 (GMT+7)

Football prediction for the Fulham - Newcastle match in the framework of the 10th round of the Premier League season 2026-2027.

Overview

Fulham is gradually improving their form after a difficult start in the Premier League. From going through the first six rounds without knowing victory, coach Alvaro Arbeloa's team has been unbeaten in three consecutive matches and only lost one in the last six rounds.

Hosting Newcastle United at Craven Cottage, Fulham has the opportunity to extend their series of positive results against an opponent who is also declining.

After two consecutive victories with the same score of 1-0 against Hull City and Coventry City, Fulham won one more point in the away match against Aston Villa in the most recent round.

Arbeloa is satisfied that his players are increasingly confident in the playing style he built. Fulham is currently ranked 15th in the standings, only two points ahead of the relegation group. The coach hopes the team will continue to improve in the journey ahead, thereby soon creating a safe gap with the bottom group.

Fulham's biggest bright spot lies in the defense. Although they have only scored nine goals, belonging to the group of three teams with the worst attacking performance in the league, they have only conceded three goals in the last six rounds. In the bottom eight teams, no club has a better defensive record than Fulham, with a total of 11 goals conceded since the beginning of the season.

Head-to-head history also brings confidence to the home team. Fulham has won three of their last four Premier League encounters against Newcastle, losing only one match. Before this period, they had gone through eight consecutive encounters without winning against opponents in the Northeast of England, with two draws and six defeats.

While Fulham is regaining stability, Newcastle is falling into a difficult period under Matthias Jaissle. The promising start of this team has now become a distant memory for fans.

The 0-1 defeat to Everton right at St James' Park made fans unable to hide their disappointment. Oves rang out in the stands after Newcastle suffered their fourth defeat in their last five matches.

This is also the second time Newcastle has lost to Everton in just five days. Previously, they were eliminated from the fourth round of the Carabao Cup after a 1-3 defeat at the opponent's home ground.

However, Jaissle affirmed that he is not worried about the decline of the "Magpies". The German coach also felt stronger support from the board of directors in the past week. However, Newcastle needs to quickly regain victory if they do not want to be deeply drawn into the battle in the bottom half of the table.

The away team is currently ranked 13th, only four points ahead of the bottom three teams. After the away match against Fulham, they will face a difficult schedule with encounters with Arsenal, Brighton, Manchester United and Sunderland after the national team gathering in November.

Newcastle may find encouragement in their away record. They just defeated Crystal Palace 2-0 in their most recent Premier League trip and are aiming for two consecutive wins away from home for the first time since April 2025. Fulham has an almost complete squad for this match. Ryan Sessegnon returned after a three-match suspension and may compete for the left-back position with Antonee Robinson.

Newcastle suffered a big loss when Joelinton was injured in the match against Everton, and Jacob Ramsey was suspended for one match after receiving a red card. Tino Livramento and Ewen Jaouen continue to be absent due to injury. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo and Lewis Miley also need to be checked before kick-off.

The match between Fulham and Newcastle takes place at 10:00 PM on November 7th (Vietnam time).

# Predicted Lineups: Fulham vs Newcastle - who could start for Cottagers, Magpies?
...
Tom Masters previews Fulham's clash against Newcastle United.

Fulham enjoyed a credible 1-1 draw away at Aston Villa last time out, to follow on from successive 1-0 wins over Hull and Coventry and now they are looking to go again against a Newcastle side who have been on a downward spiral in recent weeks.
...
Unlike the Cottagers, who have managed to win two of their last three and are unbeaten in those matches, Newcastle have lost three of their last four and have slowly drifted down the league table.

Now Fulham face them in the final clash before the November international break, with a chance to both enter that period on a high and potentially usurp Newcastle in the table, as well as, of course, pushing further away from the relegation zone.

But, before the game gets under way itself, the lineups are always something to consider and we look at how both sides might choose to lineup against Fulham at Craven Cottage on Saturday.

# Fulham Predicted Lineup

Alvaro Arbeloa knows his starting XI now and he knows it well and Fulham are now back to a full complement.
...
With Ryan Sessegnon back from his red card against Hull, he could be thrust straight back into first-team action, but having not played since October 17, he may be deemed not match fit for this one.

That will almost certainly see a unchanged back four and quite frankly, a likely unchanged starting XI.

On-field captain Calvin Bassey and David Affengruber have formed a very solid pairing at the heart of defence and while Robinson and Castagne have been far from perfect, you don't tend to change a winning team too much.

Shea Charles and Sander Berge make up Fulham's best defensive midfield pairing and will surely start again barring a late injury or illness, while Alex Iwobi, Josh King and Oscar Bobb have all proven their worth of late with match-winning goals or assists and they will all start behind Gonzalo Garcia, who is surely due a goal.
...

# Newcastle Predicted Lineup

Newcastle are definitely without Tino Livramento, who is injured, and Jacob Ramsey, who is suspended, while they may also see Lewis Miley and Matias Fernandez-Pardo ruled out due to a knock and illness, respectively.

Despite defeat last time out, Newcastle do not have the same levels of depth as previously and as a result, Matthias Jaissle may actually opt for an unchanged starting XI.

Lukas Hornicek will hope to continue his good form in goal, behind a defence that is missing Livramento, but which still packs a punch at both ends of the pitch of Lewis Hall, Dan Burn, Fabian Schar and Amar Dedic.
...
Nico Gonzalez and Joelinton will likely continue in the pivot, behind Harvey Barnes, Joe Willock, Anthony Elanga and Will Osula.

11月7日，2026-2027賽季英超第10輪，富勒姆主場迎戰紐卡斯爾聯。9輪過後，富勒姆2勝3平4負，積分9分，排第15位；紐卡斯爾聯3勝2平4負，積分11分，排第13位。兩隊積分只隔2分，這場對話帶着搶位色彩，主隊也要在主場面對排名略高對手壓力。

上一場在維拉公園，富勒姆與阿斯頓維拉踢成1-1，半場0-1落後，全場控球55%，射正5次，角球7個，下半場靠對手烏龍扳平。最近6場英超，富勒姆2勝3平1負，打進5球、丟掉4球；聯賽主場最近6場2勝1平3負，進8球、失8球。金在聯賽已有2球，射正10次，貢薩洛完成23次射門，但全隊進球轉化率只有7%，場均射正4.6次，臨門一腳效率仍是隱憂。場均控球57%、傳球成功率86.9%、角球6.2，富勒姆有望用4-2-3-1控制中場，優勢在控球和角球，風險在轉化率。

喬林頓在11月5日出現傷情，何時迴歸沒有明確說法；馬蒂亞斯·費爾南德斯-帕爾多在10月18日出現傷情，沒有明確迴歸時間；埃文·雅旺在9月30日遭遇肌肉挫傷；瓦倫蒂諾·利夫拉門託在9月19日遭遇膝關節傷勢；雅各布·拉姆齊因停賽無法出戰，紐卡斯爾聯輪換空間被壓縮。主教練在排兵佈陣上需要在穩守與快攻之間取捨，富勒姆更可能延續4-2-3-1，紐卡斯爾聯若沿用4-2-3-1，反擊效率將決定能否搶開局。

# 萨拉维亚首秀，西班牙人主场迎拉科鲁尼亚

西甲第12轮，西班牙人将于北京时间11月7日23:15（当地时间周六下午）主场迎战拉科鲁尼亚。西班牙人上一轮客场1-0击败比利亚雷亚尔，卡夫雷拉下半场打入制胜球；拉科鲁尼亚则以2-1战胜奥萨苏纳，各项赛事取得两连胜，本场力争三连胜。

本场比赛将是埃德-萨拉维亚执教西班牙人的首场比赛。此前对阵比利亚雷亚尔一役由一线队教练塞尔吉奥-加西亚带队，那场胜利也终结了西班牙人各项赛事三连败，其中包括国王杯4-3爆冷负于第四级别球队塞斯陶。

伤停方面，西班牙人预计仍将缺少卡雷拉斯和基克-加西亚，其余球员状态良好。鉴于上一场的表现和结果，球队可能沿用相同阵容。罗伯托-费尔南德斯本赛季12次出场打入7球，将继续领衔锋线。

拉科鲁尼亚方面，布莱特-埃德、埃达乔里和卡萨多仍无法入选。奥巴梅扬在因伤缺席六场比赛后，于对阵奥萨苏纳一役替补登场，本赛季联赛8场打入5球，但预计仍将替补待命，因为恩松戈最近三次出场打入两球。阿达玛-特拉奥雷在奥萨苏纳一役下半场表现抢眼，本周末预计继续替补出场。

积分榜上，西班牙人11轮3胜2平6负积11分排名第14；拉科鲁尼亚3胜5平3负积14分排名第8。交锋记录方面，西班牙人整体略占上风，39胜对35胜，双方最近一次交手是2018年2月互交白卷。西班牙人自2015年9月以来对拉科鲁尼亚保持不败，近五次交手三胜两平；拉科鲁尼亚自2007年6月以来未能在客场战胜西班牙人。

拉科鲁尼亚接下来将在11月国际比赛日前后先后对阵西班牙人和阿拉维斯，本月最后一场主场迎战巴塞罗那。

# 帕尔马主场迎博洛尼亚，吉拉迪诺盼延续复苏

北京时间11月8日01:00，帕尔马将在主场恩尼奥-塔尔迪尼球场迎战博洛尼亚。帕尔马在赛季初的困难阶段后出现复苏迹象，最近两轮拿到4分，其中包括客场3-0击败亚特兰大，主帅吉拉迪诺正帮助球队踢得更加清晰。

不过原文认为帕尔马尚未完全摆脱危机，稳定性仍是疑问。帕尔马的优势在于务实打法、保持阵型距离并等待对手犯错，但在需要主动控球和组织进攻时锐利度不足，出球能力和接近禁区时的效率都有待改善。

博洛尼亚方面状态更为出色。特德斯科执教开局不易，前4场仅1胜，但球队随后在最近5场赢下4场，包括2-1逆转蒙扎，波贝加和贝尔纳代斯基的进球体现出球队在落后时的应变能力。博洛尼亚的优势在于有组织的打法、球权运转和进攻灵活性，不容易被对手带偏节奏，但防线有时缺乏专注，尤其在对手快速转换时。

交锋记录方面，两队近6次相遇博洛尼亚3胜、帕尔马2胜、1平。上赛季首回合，帕尔马凭借奥多涅斯第90+4分钟的进球在博洛尼亚主场1-0取胜。

从当前状态看，博洛尼亚更有理由争取胜利；帕尔马拥有主场优势且刚刚重拾信心，但若想阻止对手延续上升势头，需要一场真正稳健的表现。

# Parma vs. Bologna: Emilia derby takes centre stage

Parma and Bologna are both targeting victory as they pursue their respective objectives.

An Emilia derby awaits at the Tardini on Serie A Matchday 11. Parma secured their first win under Gilardino with an impressive 3-0 victory away to Atalanta and will now look to make it two in a row against Bologna to move further clear of the relegation zone. Palladino's Bologna, however, have hit their stride and are chasing a fourth consecutive victory after beating Cagliari, AC Milan and Monza, with the aim of closing the gap to the European places.

HEAD TO HEAD

There have been 26 previous competitive meetings between the two sides in Parma: 8 wins for Parma (most recently 2-0 in Serie A 2024/25), 12 draws (most recently 2-2 in Serie A 2019/20) and 6 wins for Bologna (most recently 3-1 in Serie A 2025/26).

The 2004/05 relegation play-off was a historic meeting: Parma secured Serie A survival after losing the first leg 1-0 at home, overturning the tie with a 2-0 win at the Dall’Ara in the return leg. Parma’s second goal was scored by Gilardino, now the Ducali coach.

DID YOU KNOW?

Parma have had fewer different goalscorers than any other team (4, level with Cagliari and Venezia).

Parma have collected 4 points from their last 2 matches: for the first time this season, the Crociati have recorded back-to-back positive results, drawing 0-0 with Udinese and winning 3-0 away to Atalanta.

Parma have gone 190 minutes without scoring at home: their last home goal was scored by Almqvist in the 80th minute of Parma-Genoa 2-1 on 19 September.

Parma have gone 222 minutes without conceding in Serie A: the last goal they allowed came in Lazio-Parma 2-1 on 24 October, through a Diego Carlos own goal in the 48th minute.

Only Cagliari (40.41%) have a lower average possession percentage than Parma (40.62%).

Bologna have collected 13 points from 6 matches: since Palladino took charge, the Rossoblù have suffered just 1 defeat (Bologna-Inter 1-3). In the other 5 matches, they have recorded 4 wins and 1 draw, scoring in every game for a total of 12 goals.

Bologna have conceded more goals to substitutes than any other team (5, level with Sassuolo).

COACHES and PLAYERS

This will be the 5th official meeting between Alberto Gilardino and Raffaele Palladino: the Bologna coach leads the head-to-head with 3 wins and 1 draw. Palladino’s teams have scored in every meeting, netting 6 goals in total.

Raffaele Palladino faces one of his former clubs: he made 76 competitive appearances and scored 13 goals for Parma between January 2011 and June 2015.

Giovanni Fabbian scored against Atalanta: it was the Italian midfielder’s 1st goal of the season and his 1st-ever goal for Parma. He had not scored in Serie A since 18 January, when he netted for Bologna in a 2-1 home defeat against Fiorentina.
...

Bologna-Udinese (22/11, 15.00)

# 帕尔马 vs 博洛尼亚比分预测：模型看好博洛尼亚，最可能1-1
...
## 30 秒看懂

- 综合预测博洛尼亚胜48%，最可能比分1-1（13%）。
- 泊松模型最可能0-1（17.1%），Elo模型最可能1-1（13.5%）。
- 近5场帕尔马1胜1平3负，博洛尼亚4胜0平1负。

北京时间2026年11月8日01:00周日，意甲第11轮，帕尔马主场对阵博洛尼亚。懂球帝数据模型按开球前的历史比赛数据算出，综合三个模型的平均预测为：帕尔马胜23%、平局29%、博洛尼亚胜48%，最可能的比分是1-1（13%）、0-1（12.2%）、0-0（10.4%），预计两队合计进2.4球左右，两队都进球的概率48%。

泊松进球模型按本赛季意甲场均进球算出两队主客场进攻防守强度，再按泊松分布算比分概率并对低比分做Dixon-Coles修正。帕尔马进攻强度0.55、防守0.86，博洛尼亚进攻强度1.05、防守0.73；进球期望帕尔马0.65、博洛尼亚1.35。结果：帕尔马胜17%、平31%、博洛尼亚胜52%，最可能比分0-1（17.1%）、0-0（14.7%）、1-1（13.1%）。

近况加权模型只看两队各项赛事最近10场，越近权重越大，用加权场均进球和对手场均失球算进球期望，主场按赛事主客场进球比例加成。帕尔马加权场均进0.99球、失1.38球，博洛尼亚加权场均进1.79球、失1.31球；进球期望帕尔马1.28、博洛尼亚1.62。结果：帕尔马胜29%、平27%、博洛尼亚胜44%，最可能比分1-1（12.5%）、1-2（9.2%）、0-1（7.8%）。

Elo等级分模型按全部正式比赛从1500分起算，赛前帕尔马1706分、博洛尼亚1860分，主场优势按60分算，帕尔马胜率期望0.37；进球期望帕尔马0.94、博洛尼亚1.51。结果：帕尔马胜23%、平28%、博洛尼亚胜49%，最可能比分1-1（13.5%）、0-1（11.8%）、0-0（9.9%）。

模型近30天在意甲的战绩：泊松进球模型50场猜中胜平负25场（50%）、比分猜中5场；近况加权模型50场猜中胜平负27场（54%）、比分猜中5场；Elo等级分模型50场猜中胜平负33场（66%）、比分猜中4场。

近5场帕尔马1胜1平3负（进4失8），博洛尼亚4胜0平1负（进11失7）。本赛季意甲帕尔马10战2胜2平6负积8分，博洛尼亚10战4胜2平4负积14分。历史交锋19次，帕尔马4胜9平6负，博洛尼亚6胜9平4负。

模型只看历史数据，不知道伤停和临场变化，结果仅供参考。

本文根据懂球帝数据的报道《帕尔马vs博洛尼亚比分预测（意甲）》编译整理。

sources.summary:
# 帕尔马主场迎博洛尼亚，近6次交锋势均力敌
...
## 30 秒看懂

- 帕尔马近2轮拿4分，包括客场3-0胜亚特兰大
- 博洛尼亚近5场4胜，曾2-1逆转蒙扎
- 近6次交锋博洛尼亚3胜、帕尔马2胜、1平

意甲帕尔马与博洛尼亚将于11月8日0时在帕尔马主场恩尼奥·塔尔迪尼球场交手。帕尔马在赛季开局艰难之后出现回暖迹象，最近2轮拿到4分，其中一场是客场3比0击败萨里执教的亚特兰大。原文认为，这一结果不仅出人意料，也显示主帅阿尔贝托·吉拉迪诺开始让球队踢得更有章法。

不过原文也指出，不宜就此认定帕尔马已经走出危机。击败亚特兰大能带来士气上的提振，但稳定性仍是很大的疑问。帕尔马的优势在于务实的踢法，保持阵型距离、等待对手犯错；但当需要主动控球和组织进攻时，球队还缺少必要的锐利度，在推进和射门效率上都需要改善。

博洛尼亚方面状态更有说服力。特代斯科执教初期并不轻松，前4场只赢1场，但球队很快找回水准，最近5场赢下4场，其中包括2比1逆转蒙扎，波贝加和贝尔纳代斯基的进球说明球队在落后时反应能力不错。博洛尼亚的长处是有组织的踢法、球的转移以及进攻中的灵活性，不容易被对手带进节奏，也能在需要时提速利用空当；但被蒙扎领先也暴露出后防有时注意力不集中，尤其对手快速转换时。

两队近期交锋较为均衡：近6次相遇博洛尼亚3胜、帕尔马2胜、1平。值得一提的是，上赛季帕尔马曾在博洛尼亚主场1比0取胜，奥尔东涅斯在第90+4分钟打入制胜球，这也提醒客队不能大意。

原文在比较现状后认为，博洛尼亚更有理由争取胜利；帕尔马拥有主场优势且刚刚找回信心，但若想阻止对手延续上升势头，需要一场真正稳健的表现。

本文根据Báo的报道《Nhận định bóng đá Parma vs Bologna, 00h00 ngày 8/11: Ca khúc khải hoàn》编译整理。

Preview: Bologna vs Parma - prediction, team news, lineups

Hoping to halt their nosedive down the Serie A standings, free-falling Bologna will welcome local rivals Parma to Stadio Dall’Ara on Sunday.

Still without a home win in 2026, the Rossoblu suffered their third straight league defeat in midweek; meanwhile, the visitors have picked up just two points from their last four matches.

## Match preview

Though Bologna had more of the ball in Tuesday’s meeting with AC Milan, they offered virtually no threat and were soundly beaten 3-0, recording their fifth loss in six Serie A home games.

There is no time to reflect, though, as the Rossoblu must try to stop the rot when they meet Emilian rivals Parma, before continuing their Coppa Italia defence with a quarter-final tie against Lazio three days later.

After making a solid start to the season, Vincenzo Italiano’s side have plunged headlong into a crisis since the start of December: no team has lost more Serie A matches - seven out of 11 - and they have conceded the joint-most goals (22).

Though they recently booked a Europa League playoff against SK Brann by winning their final league-phase fixture, Bologna now sit much closer to the bottom half than Italy's European places.

Another defeat in Sunday’s lunchtime kickoff would see them suffer four consecutive league losses at the Dall’Ara for just the third time to date.

With little else to lift the mood among fans of the Felsinei, at least history suggests they can avoid such a fate: Bologna have lost just one of their last 12 top-flight clashes with Parma.

Indeed, Parma have produced a single victory from their last 16 league visits to the Dall’Ara, while they were beaten 3-1 in the reverse fixture at Stadio Tardini.

Yet, the Gialloblu would move within four points of their regional rivals with a victory this weekend, having been miles apart as recently as November.

A positive string of results had lifted Carlos Cuesta’s side away from serious danger and towards mid-table, before two heavy defeats stalled that momentum.

Losing 4-0 to Atalanta BC meant Parma had also failed to score in three straight matches; a bizarre own goal ended that drought last week, but they still lost 4-1 at home to Juventus.

Yet to suffer three successive league losses under Cuesta, the league’s second-lowest scorers will try to reverse that slump by exploiting Bologna’s leaky back line.

Bologna Serie A form:

L D W L L L

Bologna form (all competitions):

W L D L W L

Parma Serie A form:

L W D D L L

## Team News

The hosts’ struggling defence could benefit from the return of Colombian centre-back Jhon Lucumi, who has now completed his recovery from a hamstring injury.

Only veteran full-back Lorenzo De Silvestri is a doubt, giving Italiano plenty of options to choose from.

Once again, Thijs Dallinga and Santiago Castro will vie to lead Bologna’s attack: the latter’s only Serie A brace came in November’s reverse fixture, but he has scored just once on home turf this season.

Meanwhile, Parma will rely on Castro’s compatriot Mateo Pellegrino, who has scored six of their 15 league goals - and no-one else has found the net this calendar year.

Having arrived towards the end of the transfer window, new boys Gabriel Strefezza, Hans Nicolussi Caviglia and Franco Carboni could all feature at some stage.

The visitors are still missing injured goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, plus Pontus Almqvist, Lautaro Valenti, Abdoulaye Ndiaye and long-term absentee Matija Frigan.

Bologna possible starting lineup:

Skorupski; Zortea, Lucumi, Heggem, Miranda; Freuler, Ferguson; Orsolini, Odgaard, Cambiaghi; Castro

Parma possible starting lineup:

Corvi; Delprato, Circati, Troilo, Valeri; Bernabe, Keita, Nicolussi Caviglia; Ondrejka, Strefezza;
...
## We say: Bologna 2-1 Parma

Both sides have suffered big setbacks in the past week, while Bologna's mid-season malaise stretches back even further.

Even so, the Rossoblu can surely beat goal-shy Parma on home turf - though it may be a tense, close-fought contest.

# How to watch Nottingham Forest vs Manchester City live: Stream, TV, team news, prediction

Published November 4, 2026 12:04 PM

The Premier League’s unluckiest team in front of goal welcomes one of the more prolific clubs of this century when Nottingham Forest hosts Manchester City on Saturday at the City Ground.

Oliver Glasner’s Forest have turned 14.34 expected goals into just six actual markers during this young Premier League campaign.

Forest will hope that City’s midweek trip to Germany to face RB Leipzig in the Champions League helps to level the playing field, as Enzo Maresca’s men have scored 20 times in the PL and have the division’s top xG total.

City had gone three domestic matches without winning after 90 minutes, and Forest will hope to stretch that to an unlikely four.

We have team news, how to watch, and a prediction for Nottingham Forest vs Man City below.

## How to watch Nottingham Forest vs Manchester City live, stream link and start time

Kick off time: 12:30pm ET Saturday, November 4
Venue: City Ground — West Bridgford, Nottinghamshire
TV Channel: NBC
Stream link: Watch online via NBC.com

## Nottingham Forest vs Manchester City team news

Forest hope Nico Dominguez will be fit to go, while Igor Jesus and Nicolo Savona are likely to return after the international break.

City’s only big injury is Antoine Semenyo, who won’t be back for at least another month. Ruben Dias, Josko Gvardiol, and Ayyoub Bouaddi were all kept on the bench to start the match in Leipzig at midweek.

## Nottingham Forest vs Manchester City prediction

Expect an intense affair at the City Ground. Morgan Gibbs-White is the sort of player capable of unlocking an upset, but City should be plenty prepared to produce enough chances for all three points. Nottingham Forest 0-2 Man City.

# 标准晚报：曼城客战森林盼回胜轨，将派出最强首发

来源：未知 作者：佚名 发布时间：2026-11-06 05:05:13

《标准晚报》发布赛事分析，曼城对阵诺丁汉森林希望重返胜轨。

曼城将于周六客场挑战诺丁汉森林，球队希望重返胜轨。

马雷斯卡的球队上轮爆冷不敌布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩。周中的联赛杯点球取胜后，这支苏塞克斯球队在伊蒂哈德球场一周内两胜曼城。

曼城在周三的欧冠中找回状态，经过一场跌宕起伏的较量后，球队在德国红牛竞技场3-2险胜RB莱比锡。

哈兰德在对布莱顿哑火后重新破门，第78分钟打入制胜球。此前恩佐-费尔南德斯的进球在两分钟内就被努萨扳平。

马雷斯卡派出了一套强阵迎战这支德甲球队，但还是做了些轮换。

胡桑诺夫顶替鲁本-迪亚斯出任中卫，努内斯则出现在右后卫位置。

在哈兰德进球后不久，队长迪亚斯替补登场以增强稳固性，努内斯被换下，胡桑诺夫则回到边后卫位置。

福登难得在左路首发，但没能把握机会，第60分钟刚过就被多库换下。

因此，曼城主帅很可能会回到自己最熟悉的打法，面对状态不佳的森林时排出最强首发。

这意味着门前是多纳鲁马，右后卫努内斯，中卫由鲁本-迪亚斯和格伊搭档，左后卫是尼科-奥莱利；不过格瓦迪奥尔在这个位置上也有过不错表现。

在中场，恩佐-费尔南德斯和埃利奥特-安德森再次搭档，谢尔基则站在他们身前，已经坐稳首选10号位。

恩迪亚耶自从从埃弗顿加盟后表现出色，因此他应继续占据右路；左路则由多库担任首选，福登的位置由他接替。塞门约则因膝伤将缺席到12月。

预测曼城首发（4-2-3-1）：多纳鲁马；努内斯、鲁本-迪亚斯、格伊、尼科-奥莱利；埃利奥特-安德森、恩佐-费尔南德斯；恩迪亚耶、谢尔基、多库；

sources.summary:
# 诺丁汉森林主场迎战曼城，开局五轮不胜
...
- 诺丁汉森林联赛五轮不胜，排名倒数第三
- 森林本赛季联赛仅进六球，为英超最少
- 曼城联赛已两连败，周中欧冠3-2胜莱比锡

诺丁汉森林将在主场迎战曼城，寻求本赛季英超首个主场进球。森林上一轮0-2不敌布伦特福德，联赛不胜场次扩大到五场（1平4负），目前排名倒数第三。主帅格拉斯纳面临的压力可能进一步加大：如果森林成为英格兰顶级联赛历史上第四支赛季前五个主场联赛均未进球的球队，这将是一个很现实的前景——2025/26赛季在主场城市球场，他们面对上赛季前八名球队无一胜绩（4平4负），其中四场未能破门。

进攻是森林本赛季的主要问题。前九轮他们只打进六球，为英超最少，而本轮前的射门次数却达到152次，位列英超第二。

曼城是本赛季前九轮进球最多的球队，曾成为英格兰顶级联赛历史上第十支开局七连胜的球队，但此后连续负于布莱顿和阿斯顿维拉。这两场失利与此前33轮英超的输球场次持平（23胜8平），近十年间他们仅有一次遭遇更长连败。周中曼城在欧冠客场3-2击败莱比锡，备战时间受到影响；他们希望避免自去年11月以来首次连续输掉英超客场比赛，当时第一场失利正是负于维拉。

两队近九次英超交锋，森林仅胜一场（3平5负），那场胜利来自2024/25赛季主场城市球场。上赛季相应场次曼城取胜，本轮若再胜，将是1925年以来首次在顶级联赛客场对森林取得连胜。

森林本赛季四个主场联赛半场均以0-0结束；本赛季四次率先进球的联赛，他们仅胜一场（2平1负）。曼城本赛季九个联赛客场进球中有八个来自下半场；近六个联赛客场胜利中有五场零封对手。

摩根·吉布斯-怀特本场将迎来个人第200次英超出场，其中为森林出战151场，是俱乐部英超时代第三多；森林升级以来唯一一次交锋胜利中，他送出助攻。曼城的哈兰德以九球领跑英超射手榜，其中四球为比赛首开纪录，但近三次联赛交锋他未参与进球。双方目前似乎均无新的伤病问题。

原文末尾提到“森林的颓势在对阵联赛最强球队之一时终结的可能性不大，因此曼城零封取胜可能具有价值”，该内容为博彩倾向，未纳入本稿。

本文根据Flashscore.co.za的报道《Nottingham Forest v Manchester City LIVE 07/11/2026 | Soccer》编译整理。

sources.summary:
# 泰尔齐奇：加拉雷塔复出帕雷德斯伤缺；德比战必须赢下对抗

北京时间本周日凌晨，西甲第12轮将上演一场激烈的巴斯克大区较量，毕尔巴鄂竞技将客场挑战奥萨苏纳。赛前，毕尔巴鄂竞技主帅埃丁-泰尔齐奇出席了在莱萨马训练基地举行的新闻发布会，详细通报了队内伤病动态，深入剖析了萨达尔球场的德比难点与战术部署，并就裁判争议、特内里费球员猝逝哀悼以及国际比赛日等热点话题作出了详尽回应。

以下为新闻发布会完整实录：

▍伤情通报：加拉雷塔完全复出，帕雷德斯伤缺，塞拉诺与贾洛存疑
...
泰尔齐奇：你们一直在密切关注球队的日常训练。有时球员没出现在全队热身中，是因为他们在健身房进行个人针对性激活，这并不意味着他们一定受了伤。为了让大家更清晰，我简要通报一下：

前锋线上，古鲁塞塔和马罗安-桑纳迪将铁定缺席本场比赛。后防线上，帕雷德斯上周在对阵皇家社会赛前热身时感到肌肉疼痛，检查后确诊为轻度肌肉损伤，他无法出战本周末对阵奥萨苏纳的比赛；我们希望他下周能回归球场训练，并在国家队比赛日结束后彻底复出。

好消息是“银河”（加拉雷塔的昵称）。他一直在循序渐进地增加训练量，昨天几乎参与了全队的所有环节，今天他预计将完成100%的高强度训练，他已经做好了完全复出的准备。

目前阵容里还有两个问号：尼科-塞拉诺和阿尔瓦罗-贾洛。两人昨天都没有参与全队合练。尼科在国王杯后出现了轻微的肌肉反应，类似季前备战时的问题；阿尔瓦罗周三训练表现极佳，但不幸在拼抢中被踢到了小腿，出现严重硬伤，昨天甚至连走路都伴有明显痛感。我们还要观察今天的训练情况，希望他们两人中至少有一人能赶上明天的比赛。

▍展望萨达尔德比：客战充满激烈情绪，德马科斯带来丰富情报
...
泰尔齐奇： 我期待一场充斥着强烈情绪与对抗的客场德比大战。我们做足了充分的备战工作，详细复盘了奥萨苏纳在阿尔萨特治下的比赛打法。

在教练组内部，奥斯卡-德马科斯给了我极大的帮助。他职业生涯在萨达尔球场与奥萨苏纳交手过无数次，深知在这座球场踢球意味着什么，他向我传授了极其关键的内幕与实战经验。

我们研究了两队近年来的交锋记录，进球往往非常少，场面极其胶着、对抗凶悍，萨达尔的主场氛围注定会无比狂热。我们已经证明了球队正走在正确的道路上，并具备在顶级强度下竞争的实力。我们的核心目标是将近期比赛中展现出的所有积极一面带到明天的赛场，保持稳定与高效，全力争夺3分。

▍战术哲学：争胜始于高位选位，不仅要拼赢对抗更要拿稳二点球
...
一切都始于优秀的整体选位，以及敢于直面硬仗的战斗心态。

我喜欢时刻准备对抗、主动寻求对抗、敢于身体肉搏并最终赢下对抗的球员。但这绝不仅限于赢下第一点拼抢，更要确保拿下第二落点并控制球权。我们对阵赫塔费时就面对过密集的传中与长传，防守时必须有预判意识——时刻做好为队友补位的保护准备。

在防守理念上，我们之所以坚持高位压迫，就是为了让对手远离我们的禁区。一旦在前场丢失球权，合理的站位能让我们第一时间展开极具侵略性的就地反抢。在逼抢中必须保持耐心，确保我们的逼抢路线短于对手的出球距离。合理的选位，永远是球队打出统治力与侵略性对抗的坚实基石。

sources.title: 阿拉萨特率奥萨苏纳迎战毕尔巴鄂竞技
sources.summary:
# 阿拉萨特率奥萨苏纳迎战毕尔巴鄂竞技
...
- 阿拉萨特重返奥萨苏纳帅位，球队近两轮连败
- 阿拉萨特执教生涯18次对阵毕尔巴鄂竞技，战绩占优
- 毕尔巴鄂竞技近10次联赛做客萨达尔球场7胜1平2负

奥萨苏纳将在萨达尔球场迎战毕尔巴鄂竞技，主队主帅哈戈巴·阿拉萨特再次与这个老对手相遇。阿拉萨特在奥萨苏纳联赛开局不佳、拉米斯被解职后回到球队帅位，肩负带队走出困境的任务。他回归后的首战率队战胜了桑坦德竞技，但随后遭遇两连败，潘普洛纳方面再次拉响警报。面对毕尔巴鄂竞技，奥萨苏纳急需积分，这场比赛对主队而言几乎等同于一场决赛。

对毕尔巴鄂竞技来说，对阵阿拉萨特和奥萨苏纳有两种相反的参照。毕尔巴鄂竞技与这位来自贝里亚图阿的教练（先后执教奥萨苏纳、马略卡和皇家社会）共交手18次，总战绩处于下风；但萨达尔球场恰恰是毕尔巴鄂竞技在联赛中较为偏爱的客场之一。

数据也支持这一点。最近10场在潘普洛纳进行的联赛，毕尔巴鄂竞技取得7胜1平2负，最近一次失利是2023年5月25日的0比2，这10场比赛的进球比为18比9。从历史交锋看，毕尔巴鄂竞技在联赛中45次做客奥萨苏纳，取得20胜13平12负，进72球失51球。

不过，阿拉萨特在执教奥萨苏纳期间对阵毕尔巴鄂竞技的战绩并不落下风。他带队共12次面对毕尔巴鄂竞技（10场联赛、2场杯赛），取得4胜4平4负。他首次以主教练身份在顶级联赛对阵毕尔巴鄂竞技是在2014年1月5日，当时他率领皇家社会在阿诺埃塔球场2比0取胜，对手由埃内斯托·巴尔韦德执教。2019-20赛季，他首次以奥萨苏纳主帅身份对阵毕尔巴鄂竞技，2019年11月24日在萨达尔球场1比2告负；此后他又带队踢了11场，最近一次是2024年5月15日在圣马梅斯2比2战平。

离开奥萨苏纳后，阿拉萨特执教马略卡，与毕尔巴鄂竞技交手4次，取得1胜2平1负，最近一次是上赛季1月马略卡3比2取胜。2026年2月离开马略卡后，阿拉萨特经历了一段等待期，与家人（他有三个孩子）回到曾执教奥萨苏纳时居住的纳瓦拉穆蒂尔瓦。他利用这段时间陪伴家人并继续观看足球比赛，还曾应卡洛·安切洛蒂之邀前往巴西。阿拉萨特回忆说：“他给我打了电话，关心我的情况，对我说如果我没有别的计划，那么和家人一起去里约热内卢是个不错的计划。”

阿拉萨特也观察过其他教练的工作，例如现任阿贾克斯主帅米歇尔。在卡洛斯·科尔贝兰离任、布拉乌利奥（阿拉萨特的朋友、奥萨苏纳前体育总监）抵达梅斯塔利亚后，他的名字也曾与瓦伦西亚联系在一起。最终，潘普洛纳方面拉米斯下课，阿拉萨特回到了自己的家、自己的帅位，承担起带领奥萨苏纳走出困境的艰巨任务；目前他带队的成绩是一胜两负。

本文根据El Correo的报道《Jagoba Arrasate vuelve a cruzarse en el camino》编译整理。

sources.summary:
# 欧塞尔主场迎战巴黎FC，西纳约科反戈旧主
...
- 法甲第10轮欧塞尔主场迎战巴黎FC，7日19点开球
- 西纳约科今夏转会巴黎FC，以8球领跑法甲射手榜
- 巴黎FC主席费拉奇此役后卸任，阿尔诺接替将宣布

法甲第10轮，欧塞尔将于11月7日19点在阿贝-德尚球场迎战巴黎FC。欧塞尔目前排名第14，上一轮客场1比5惨败斯特拉斯堡；巴黎FC则以第4名的身份来到客场，9轮仅负2场，落后榜首3分。

《队报》记者阿尔诺·埃尔芒在ICI欧塞尔的节目中点评了对手的打法：“他们自赛季开始以来在出球和由后向前的推进质量令人相当吃惊。他们几乎能从六码线附近起脚，通过一脚出球摆脱逼抢，然后向前推进到形成射门。整体上这是一支相当均衡的球队，利亚姆·罗西尼尔的原则非常清晰：高位逼抢，想要控球、保持球权、必要时转移，但最重要的是执行高位逼抢。”

本场焦点人物是拉萨内·西纳约科。这名马里前锋今夏从欧塞尔转会巴黎FC，此前他为欧塞尔出战175场职业比赛。本赛季他已打入8球，位居法甲射手榜首位，并直接参与了巴黎FC16个进球中的13个。

巴黎FC于2025年5月重返法国足球顶级联赛，结束了长达46年的法甲缺席。俱乐部由阿尔诺家族与奥地利红牛集团共同推动的新项目支撑。不过其客场战绩相对起伏：2负1平1胜。

埃尔芒还提到，这场比赛超出竞技层面：自2012年起担任巴黎FC主席的皮埃尔·费拉奇将在欧塞尔完成任内最后一战，随后被授予荣誉主席。埃尔芒表示：“周六在欧塞尔将是皮埃尔·费拉奇作为俱乐部主席的最后一场比赛。之后他会被任命为荣誉主席。他的离任将正式公布，11月9日董事会会议后，将宣布由安托万·阿尔诺接替。”

欧塞尔方面，上一轮1比5不敌斯特拉斯堡后急需重整。《约讷共和报》体育记者朱利安·本·布阿利仍看到一点积极之处：詹姆斯·周在离开一年半后回到约讷。

本场比赛前，ICI欧塞尔将于18点30分开始赛前节目，公布双方首发，19点开球。

本文根据ici.fr的报道《Le prochain match de l'AJA contre le Paris FC, vu d'en face : "une qualité dans la sortie de balle assez bluffante"》编译整理。

# 巴黎FC客战欧塞尔，西纳约科出战成疑
...
- 巴黎FC积17分排第四，客场四战仅得4分。
- 欧塞尔联赛失球23个为法甲最多，迪乌巴特停赛。
- 巴黎FC头号射手西纳约科等多人因伤出战成疑。

法甲第10轮，欧塞尔将在主场阿贝-德尚球场迎战巴黎FC，两队目前在积分榜上相差十个名次。巴黎FC在罗塞尼奥的带领下九轮过后积17分排名第四，与第三名里昂同分，落后第二名里尔一分，距离同城对手巴黎圣日耳曼三分。如果本轮巴黎FC全取三分而巴黎圣日耳曼输给特鲁瓦，巴黎FC理论上可以在周末结束时并列榜首。

巴黎FC本赛季的主场表现强势，在让-布安球场保持不败，五场主场比赛拿到13分。但客场战绩拖了后腿，四场客场比赛输掉一半，最近两个客场先后以0比1不敌洛里昂、1比2负于朗斯。球队自十月初客场3比2击败马赛之后便再未在客场取胜，客场12分中仅拿到4分。

欧塞尔方面，斯蒂尔执教的球队开局起伏不定，九轮联赛中有八场未能零封对手。他们唯一一场零封是九月份1比0击败尼斯，此后便再未保持球门不失。欧塞尔目前排名第14位，联赛失球数达到23个，比垫底的勒阿弗尔还多三个，是法甲防守最差的球队。不过欧塞尔在主场失球和进球均为五个，主场四场比赛拿到7分，这为球队提供了一定信心。

人员方面，欧塞尔中场拉姆菲亚·迪乌巴特在上轮1比5负于斯特拉斯堡的比赛中第11分钟被罚下，本场停赛。塞库·福法纳因腹股沟问题出战成疑，布莱恩·奥科、雷米·拉博·拉斯卡里和阿萨内·迪乌塞均因伤缺阵。前锋卡梅伦·阿彻以六个进球领跑队内射手榜，比丹尼·纳马索多三个。

巴黎FC可能缺少法甲头号射手拉辛·西纳约科，他本赛季打入八球，位列联赛射手榜首位，另有五次助攻。西纳约科的进球占巴黎FC联赛16个进球的一半，若他缺阵，球队进攻端将更多依赖马克西姆·洛佩斯和巴勃罗·帕吉斯，两人是队内除西纳约科外仅有的进球超过一个的球员。此外，阿达马·卡马拉（腿筋）、卢卡·科莱奥肖（肌肉）、乔纳森·伊科内（大腿）和恩霍亚·桑吉（肌肉）均存在伤病疑问。

预计首发方面，欧塞尔可能排出：纳尔迪；马科索、图安泽贝、阿克帕；西、达努瓦、阿哈马达、奥佩高；费弗尔、纳马索；阿彻。巴黎FC方面可能为：特拉普；特拉奥雷、切尔吉、科波拉、奥塔维奥；洛佩斯、莱斯梅卢；凯巴尔、帕吉斯、西蒙；西索科。

# Preview: Auxerre vs. Paris FC - prediction, team news, lineups

Ten places separate Auxerre and Paris FC in the Ligue 1 table ahead of Saturday's matchday 10 fixture at Stade de l'Abbe-Deschamps.

Liam Rosenior's men could theoretically finish the weekend joint-top if they secure maximum points against the side with the division's worst defensive record and Paris Saint-Germain lose to Troyes.

## Match preview

Rosenior faced considerable criticism after his forgettable spell at Chelsea earlier this year, but the Englishman has Paris FC flying after nine matchdays.

Les Bleus sit fourth in the division with 17 points from a possible 27, level with third-placed Lyon, one behind second-placed Lille and just three adrift of local rivals PSG.

Much of their early-season success admittedly stems from their strong form at Stade Jean-Bouin, where they remain unbeaten after collecting 13 of a possible 15 points.

However, they have struggled to replicate those performances on their travels, losing half of their four away matches, including the last two against Lorient (1-0) and Lens (2-1).

Paris have not won away since early October's 3-2 success at Marseille, and a return of just four points from 12 on the road undermines their prospects of drawing level with PSG before Luis Enrique's men face Troyes later on Saturday.

Will Still's Auxerre have made a patchy start to the campaign, compounded by their failure to keep clean sheets in eight of their nine Ligue 1 fixtures.

The 14th-placed club's only shutout came in September's 1-0 victory over Nice, but Les Ajaistes have been unable to keep opponents at bay since.

That defensive weakness leaves Still's team vulnerable, and they enter Saturday's encounter having conceded 23 league goals, three more than bottom-placed Le Havre, further underlining their difficulties.

While their 13 goals exceed the totals of all but two bottom-half clubs, Brest (16) and Strasbourg (17), this weekend's hosts leave themselves with considerable work to do by conceding far too freely.

Nonetheless, eagle-eyed observers will note that Auxerre have conceded just five goals in front of their supporters while scoring as many themselves, offering encouragement ahead of matchday 10.

Given Paris' away struggles, Les Ajaistes, who have collected seven points from 12 on home soil, will back themselves to secure maximum points against Rosenior's high-flying side.

Lamfia Dioubate was dismissed after 11 minutes of the 5-1 defeat to Strasbourg last time out, leaving Auxerre without the midfielder.

While Sekou Fofana is touch-and-go due to a groin issue, Bryan Okoh, Remy Labeau Lascary and Assane Diousse are all sidelined for the hosts.

Cameron Archer leads Auxerre's scoring charts with six goals, three more than Danny Namaso, and the Englishman will aim to build on his prolific start to the campaign.

Paris, meanwhile, could be without Ligue 1's leading scorer Lassine Sinayoko, whose eight goals surpass everyone else's tally in the competition, while his five assists underline his dual threat.

Given that Sinayoko has scored half of Les Bleus' 16 league goals, the visitors may have to rely on alternative sources; only Maxime Lopez and Pablo Pagis have also scored more than once for Rosenior's side, leaving the manager short of proven match-winners.

# Preview: Alverca vs Casa Pia - prediction, team news, lineups

Alverca will be looking to avoid a fourth consecutive defeat in all competitions when they welcome Casa Pia to the Complexo Desportivo FC Alverca on Saturday evening for their Liga Portugal Matchday 11 encounter.

Sergio Ferreira's side sit 10th in the Primeira Liga table, four points and six places above their visitors, who currently occupy one of the two outright relegation spots.

## Match preview

Alverca's second consecutive campaign in the Portuguese top flight has been characterised by spells of inconsistency, with a three-match winning run against Nacional, Rio Ave and Famalicao between mid-September and October sandwiched between winless periods.

Ferreira's men had failed to win any of their opening five fixtures before finding their feet, but they have since returned to familiar struggles after losing their last three outings without scoring, beginning with a Taca de Portugal elimination at the hands of lower-league Tondela before suffering successive 1-0 league losses to Arouca and Benfica.

Looking to avoid a third consecutive defeat in the top-flight for the first time since December 2025, the Ribatejo outfit must also find greater balance at both ends of the pitch, having scored 13 goals and conceded 14 in 10 Primeira Liga matches, with multiple strikes coming just once and only one clean sheet recorded during that period.

Alverca’s home form has offered little encouragement either, as Ferreira's side have managed just one victory in five matches on their own turf this season (D2, L2), with their most recent outing at the venue ending in defeat to Arouca.

The hosts can nevertheless draw some confidence from previous results in this fixture, having won both league meetings with the Geese last season, recording a 2-0 victory in Rio Maior before following it up with a 3-1 success on home soil in April.

Casa Pia find themselves in a similarly difficult position after finishing 16th last season and securing their top-flight status through the relegation playoff, with their disappointing start to the current campaign largely down to shortcomings at both ends of the pitch.

Filipe Coelho's men have scored a joint-league-low five goals in the Primeira Liga this term, while only Maritimo (20) and Rio Ave (23) have conceded more than Os Gansos' 19, with their lack of cutting edge in attack once again evident in last weekend's 2-0 defeat to Sporting Lisbon.

There are, however, signs of improvement compared to their opening six fixtures, during which the Geese went without a victory, having now won two of their last four league matches and three of their most recent five across all competitions, including a Taca de Portugal triumph over lower-league Alpendorada.

A return to the road this weekend could also work in the visitors' favour, considering all seven of their league points this season have come away from home, with those results arriving across their last three trips, including a 2-0 victory over Estrela Amadora on their most recent outing.

# Roma aim to take second place with win against Sassuolo

Roma host Sassuolo with a view to closing the gap to the leaders, while the Neroverdi are in desperate need of points in their fight for survival.

Three points would see Roma leapfrog Inter and move within one point of leaders Lazio, at least for a night. Still unbeaten in the league, Roma host Sassuolo looking for a third consecutive victory after wins against Cagliari and Udinese. However, former Roma player Aquilani, who made 102 Serie A appearances and scored nine goals for the Giallorossi, needs his Sassuolo side to start picking up points after four straight defeats.

HEAD TO HEAD

There have been 12 previous competitive meetings between the two sides in Rome: 6 wins for Roma (most recently 2-0 in Serie A 2025/26), 5 draws (most recently 0-0 in Serie A 2020/21) and just 1 away win for Sassuolo (4-3 in Serie A 2022/23).

Roma have scored in 11 of their last 12 matches against Sassuolo: the only exception was the 0-0 draw in Serie A 2020/21. They scored 24 goals across the other 11 meetings.

DID YOU KNOW?

Roma are unbeaten in their last 17 matches in Italian competitions: 13 wins and 4 draws. Their last defeat came on 5 April (Inter-Roma 5-2, Serie A).

Roma have had more different goalscorers than any other team (12, level with Lazio).

Roma have scored more goals through substitutes than any other team (7).

Sassuolo have conceded more goals to substitutes than any other team (5, level with Bologna).

This match brings together the team with the most goals scored (Roma, 28) and the team with the most goals conceded (Sassuolo, 26).

Sassuolo have conceded more goals than any other team in the opening 15 minutes of the second half (7).

Sassuolo have conceded more penalties than any other team (3, level with Atalanta, Frosinone and Venezia).

Sassuolo have collected just 1 point from their last 6 league matches (Sassuolo-Milan 1-1). Their last victory came on 13 September (Sassuolo-Juventus 3-2, Serie A).

Sassuolo have kept just 1 clean sheet in competitive matches this season: the 3-0 home win over Cesena in the Coppa Italia Round of 64.

COACHES and PLAYERS

This will be the first official meeting between Gian Piero Gasperini and Alberto Aquilani.

Alberto Aquilani faces one of his former clubs: as a Roma player, he made 149 appearances and scored 15 goals, in 2002/03 and from 2004/05 to 2008/09.

Daniele Ghilardi scored against Udinese: it was his 1st goal for Roma and the Italian defender’s 1st Serie A goal.

sources.title: Sassuolo's shortcomings help Roma star cement his superiority over Raphinha and Kane | Goal.com India

# Sassuolo's failure helps Roma star to confirm his superiority over Raphinha and Kane

Roma chase a record absent for 13 years

Matchday 11 of the Italian league, broadcast on stc tv, gets under way this Friday evening when Venezia host Udinese.

Four more matches follow on Saturday, with the pick of them Roma's clash against Sassuolo at the Olimpico.

According to the Opta statistics network, Roma have avoided defeat in 22 of their 24 Serie A meetings with Sassuolo, winning 13 and drawing nine while losing just twice.

The capital club have also won their last four against Sassuolo, a record run of consecutive wins over the Neroverdi in the competition.

Sassuolo have managed just one win in 12 away trips to Roma in Serie A, drawing five and losing six. That solitary victory arrived in a 4-3 thriller on 12 March 2023, when Armand Lauriente scored twice and set up another.

Only four sides remain unbeaten in Europe's big five leagues this season. Roma are one of them, alongside Lazio, Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund.

Seven wins and three draws have taken Roma this far in the 2026-2027 campaign. Avoid defeat on Saturday and they go unbeaten through their first 11 Serie A matches for only the third time in their history. They managed it in 2013-2014, when the run stretched to the 17th match, and in 2003-2004, when it reached the 14th.

No Roma side has ever attacked like this one. The league's most potent frontline, they have scored 28 goals in their first 10 matches, a club first.

Opta also point to Sassuolo's form: four straight Serie A defeats. The club have suffered five or more consecutive losses in the competition only once, between January and March 2014, when they lost seven in a row.

Sassuolo have not won on the road in the league since 15 February, when they beat Udinese 2-1. Since then they have taken three draws and eight defeats from 11 away matches, and lost six of their last seven away, drawing the other.

At the other end of the table for defences, Sassuolo own the league's leakiest. They have conceded 26 goals after 10 matches, the most at this stage in their Serie A history.

Donyell Malen leads the scoring charts across Europe's big five leagues in 2026. The Roma man has 22 goals, one clear of Raphinha and Harry Kane, who sit on 21 apiece.

Dig into the numbers and the Dutch striker stands alone. He is the only player in the big five leagues to reach double figures both at home (10 goals) and away (12 goals) this calendar year.

# 罗马主场迎战萨索洛，意甲不败金身待续
...
- 罗马欧冠2-0领先遭曼联3-2逆转，近六场首败
- 罗马本季意甲7胜3平不败，主场联赛17场不败
- 萨索洛六轮不胜且客场自二月起未胜

罗马将在意甲主场迎战萨索洛，希望在国际比赛日到来前用一场胜利走出周中欧冠失利的阴影。周二欧冠对阵曼联，罗马在2-0领先的情况下被对手3-2逆转，这是他们近六场各项赛事（4胜1平）的首场失利。

回到意甲赛场，加斯佩里尼执教的罗马本赛季仍保持不败，战绩为7胜3平，有望队史第三次在赛季前11场意甲中保持不败。球队还将受益于回到奥林匹克球场——他们最近三个主场各项赛事全部取胜，最近17场意甲主场13胜4平保持不败。

萨索洛上一轮2-4不敌佛罗伦萨，不胜场次扩大到六场（1平5负）。本轮开始时他们仅领先降级区1分，且已遭遇四连败，若再输球将带着身处降级区的处境进入国际比赛日，同时创下队史意甲第二长连败纪录。阿奎拉尼的球队客场形势同样严峻，自二月以来意甲客场未尝胜绩（3平8负），最近七个客场输掉六场。

交锋记录方面，罗马最近四次意甲对阵萨索洛全部取胜，创下这一对阵的顶级联赛连胜纪录。萨索洛12次意甲客场挑战罗马仅赢过1场（5平6负）。

数据层面，罗马本赛季联赛已有八场上半场零封；最近七个联赛主场每场至少打进2球；萨索洛本赛季联赛尚未零封；萨索洛最近13场意甲客场有10场双方均取得进球。

球员方面，苏莱在上次两队交锋罗马2-0取胜时贡献进球和助攻，最近四场俱乐部比赛参与4球（2球2助攻）。劳里恩特对佛罗伦萨梅开二度，职业生涯对罗马打进2球，均来自2023年3月萨索洛在同一场地4-3取胜的比赛。

罗马的伦施在对曼联的比赛中受伤，预计缺阵三周；戈利尼因伤缺席了那场比赛。萨索洛没有新的重要伤病，索尔斯泰德解禁复出。
